Sentence (English): I've had to replace the pump filter on this dishwasher twice, each time costing about 90 USD for the part alone, not counting my time and effort.
Comments (English): [ Expensive, fragile pump filter and terrible design ] || ---------------- || I've had to replace the pump filter on this dishwasher twice, each time costing about 90 USD for the part alone, not counting my time and effort. The main issue is a fundamental design flaw in the filtration system.The only accessible triangular filter catches only large debris and completely fails to stop smaller pieces. In my case, a roughly half‑inch piece of wire from a bread bag twist tie passed straight through, was not caught by the main filter, and destroyed the internal metal circular pump filter. I replaced it at my own expense.Less than a year later, the same thing happened again, this time with a tiny piece of transparent plastic, probably from a bottle or cup, under a centimeter in size. Despite cleaning the accessible filter before every wash, that small piece still got through and once again ruined the fine metal pump filter.Each failure cost me around one hundred dollars for a new filter plus a couple of hours of work: reading error codes, running diagnostics and calibration, pulling the dishwasher out, disassembling it, replacing the part, and reinstalling everything. For a modern appliance, this level of fragility and maintenance is unacceptable.In my opinion, this is a terrible design. A dishwasher should not allow such small, everyday bits of household debris to bypass the main filter and destroy a critical internal component so easily and so expensively. I would not recommend this model to anyone until the filtration and pump protection design is significantly improved.I have attached photos of the destroyed internal filters alongside the triangular filter that is supposed to protect them, but clearly fails to catch small hard pieces that accidentally end up in the dishwasher.

Sentence (English): We've been using this Bosch dishwasher for about two weeks now, and so far, our impression is quite positive.
Comments (English): [ Good value for money ] || ---------------- || We've been using this Bosch dishwasher for about two weeks now, and so far, our impression is quite positive. Overall, we think it's an appliance with excellent value for money. It's clearly a reliable brand, and the appliance feels robust and well-finished. One of the things we liked most is how quiet it is. When it's running, you can barely hear it, which is a big plus, especially if you run it at night or if the kitchen is close to the living room. In that respect, it performs perfectly. As for the washing, so far it **leaves the dishes quite clean** even using normal programs. You don't usually need to pre-rinse the dishes unless they have very stubborn food residue. Furthermore, the interior is well-organized and allows you to load plates, glasses, and cutlery without any problems. It's true that the **energy efficiency rating is D**, which isn't ideal these days, as there are more efficient models available. Even so, considering the price and how well it works, we don't think it's a major drawback. Since we've only been using it for two weeks, it's still too early to assess its durability, but our initial impressions are very positive. If it continues to perform this way over time, we believe it was a worthwhile purchase.
Comments (Original): [ Buenas calidad-precio ] || ---------------- || Llevamos usando este lavavajillas Bosch unas dos semanas y, de momento, la valoración es bastante positiva. En general, nos parece un electrodoméstico con muy buena relación calidad-precio. Se nota que es una marca fiable y el aparato se ve robusto y bien acabado.Uno de los aspectos que más nos ha gustado es lo silencioso que es. Cuando está funcionando apenas se oye, algo que se agradece mucho, sobre todo si lo pones por la noche o si la cocina está cerca del salón. En ese sentido, cumple perfectamente.En cuanto al lavado, por ahora **deja la vajilla bastante limpia** incluso usando programas normales. No suele hacer falta prelavar los platos, salvo que tengan restos muy pegados. Además, el interior está bien organizado y permite colocar platos, vasos y cubiertos sin problema.Es verdad que la **eficiencia energética es D**, lo cual no es lo mejor hoy en día, ya que hay modelos más eficientes. Aun así, teniendo en cuenta el precio y cómo funciona, tampoco nos parece un punto negativo demasiado importante.Como solo llevamos dos semanas utilizándolo, todavía es pronto para valorar la durabilidad, pero las primeras sensaciones son muy buenas. Si sigue funcionando así con el tiempo, creemos que ha sido una compra acertada.

This dishwasher is so quiet that I genuinely have to check the indicator light to know if it's running. I can start a cycle while everyone else in the house is sleeping or focusing and it never interrupts a moment. The rack design is another standout feature. The adjustable racks and flexible layout make it incredibly easy to fit everything—from large mixing bowls to tall water bottles. The third rack is perfect for utensils and small items, which frees up a lot of space below. I also appreciate the thoughtful details: the sleek top-control panel keeps the front looking clean and modern, the stainless interior feels extremely durable, and the drying performance is excellent—even plastics come out dry more often than not. Sentence (English): My relationship with my wife improved after purchasing a dishwasher.
Comments (English): My relationship with my wife improved after purchasing a dishwasher. Between working and childcare, I used to barely manage to eat when I came home late, and seeing the pile of dishes would just make me sigh. As the various household chores piled up, stress built up along with it, and as my emotions became increasingly sensitive, our arguments grew more frequent. To reduce the housework, I looked into dishwashers; I noticed that built-in models with 12- to 16 place settings usually require renovation installation. Since I wanted a simple installation, I purchased a 6-place setting model. I hesitated for a while because it is small and not a very popular appliance, but now that I’ve used it, I think I should have bought it sooner. It holds more dishes than I expected, and I realized that unless you plan to put pots and pans in it, a large size isn't really necessary. The most important factor is the time it takes to wash dishes. Since I just have to roughly remove stuck-on food, stack the dishes neatly, and run the cycle, the time I have to do things manually is very short, and the dishwasher takes care of the rest. By saving anywhere from 20 minutes to an hour of dinner time like this, I found myself having more leeway in childcare and time to rest. As a result, family conflicts gradually disappeared. I am truly very satisfied with this product. If anyone is going through a similar situation, I would definitely recommend it.

Personally, I would never buy another Haier product again, they are cheap for a reason. Poor man pays twice in this case.

Comments (English): [ Silverware basket has a design flaw ] || ---------------- || I replaced my GE portable dishwasher which broke down at age 7 (stopped draining water) with the same GE appliance because I didn't want to spend half the purchase price for repair. When you are looking for a portable dishwasher on wheels you usually have 2 choices: GE or Whirlpool. I would never buy whirlpool because its interior is plastic which is prone to tub holes-GE is stainless steel. The GE features haven't changed much in 7 yrs other than the design of the lower rack, the handle of the silverware basket and the tablet dispenser. The handle of the silverware basket broke after one week of use and is getting replaced by GE. They changed the design of its handle which is a big design flaw. The other problem I had after arrival was that the hose and unicouple wouldn't fit back into its storage department. It did improve over time and stays put better. The dishwasher did come with protective film which needed to be removed. This GE dishwasher still doesn't have a dry cycle which would have been beneficial if that feature was added after a decade. So if the drying feature is a deal breaker for you whirlpool is your choice. My deal breaker was a stainless steel interior! Very satisfied with Home Depot from start to finish and they are now the only store I will buy appliances from.

Comments (English): [ Smart dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I’m going to leave an honest review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Dishwasher (Built-in 12-Place Capacity DW80F71Y1UEWS), which includes on-site installation. As this is my first time using a dishwasher, I was a bit skeptical, but after actually using it, I felt like dishwashing time had practically disappeared, so my satisfaction level was quite high. In particular, the feature where the AI detects the level of dirt on the dishes and automatically adjusts the wash intensity and time was very convenient. Design. The Essential White color makes the kitchen look much brighter and cleaner. Since it is a built-in model, it blends naturally with the lower sink cabinets, giving the interior a neat and organized feel. True to the Samsung BESPOKE line, the overall design is minimal, so it blends well with the kitchen atmosphere. The handles are also understated and clean, making it a design that fits well with the modern vibe of newlywed homes. Performance. AI Custom Wash. Sensors detect the level of dirt and automatically adjust the wash time, temperature, and number of rinses. So, I didn't have to worry about choosing a course every time; I could just run it. Cleaning Power. Perhaps because of the 4-stage 3D water jet structure, even pots and greasy dishes are cleaned quite thoroughly. Even ramen pots and greasy dishes tend to come out clean in a single wash. Sterilization Function: When using the high-temperature sterilization course, it supports a function that eliminates up to 99.999% of bacteria. This makes it great for washing baby bottles or dishes where hygiene is a priority. Smart Features: It connects with the SmartThings app, allowing you to check the operating status or set courses via your phone. It also supports Bixby for voice control. Value for Money: Among dishwashers from major manufacturers, the feature configuration is quite good. With AI automatic washing, sterilization, and smart app connectivity, it is an appliance that can significantly reduce dishwashing time once installed. I was particularly satisfied that it is a 12-place setting model, making it convenient to handle the family's dishes all at once. Areas for Improvement: You need to get a feel for dish placement at first. Plastic containers are not always dried perfectly. Since it is a built-in model, checking the installation space is essential. However, I didn't experience any major inconveniences while using it. Recommended for: Those who want to reduce dishwashing time. Those looking for a new home or built-in kitchen appliances. For those who want hygienic sterilization cleaning, and for those who enjoy using smart appliances. To sum it up, it is a smart dishwasher that significantly reduces dishwashing stress. At first, I thought it was a luxury appliance, but after actually using it, I realized why everyone uses dishwashers.

Sentence (English): I thought the catch thing at the bottom was THE FILTER, but I was wrong.
Comments (English): [ Filter is not easy to get to ] || ---------------- || I thought the catch thing at the bottom was THE FILTER, but I was wrong. Now after 1.5 years of using this dishwasher my partner and I noticed it sounds louder than it used to in terms of motor noise. Come to find out we need to take out the pump motor from the outside (aka completely uninstall it) to get to a filter that catches all the food chunks that easily get past the pull out filter at the inside bottom, that has rather large holes for a "filter". Really bummed that trying to clean a filter has turned into such a hassel that will probably be an every 6 month or less thing now that we know.

It is working perfectly without any issues. LG Objet Dishwasher Installation. Perfect from sink renovation to installation! It is natural to hesitate when buying a single appliance if the installation process is complicated, but this LG dishwasher installation was truly impressive. I am leaving this detailed review in the hopes it will be helpful to those who are buying a dishwasher for the first time like me, or those who are concerned about kitchen base cabinet renovations. 1. Meticulous pre-installation inspection and friendly guidance. The day before installation, the technician called to coordinate the visit time. Since my home is a built-in model, renovation of the sink base cabinets was essential. The technician carefully checked over the phone beforehand whether cabinet work was necessary and what the dimensions were, which put my mind at ease. Honestly, I was worried because I thought separate companies would need to come for the appliance installation and the furniture renovation. However, I felt very relieved to hear that the LG installation technician would personally handle everything from sink renovation to dishwasher installation in one go. 2. Construction cost benefits obtained by selecting the 'Hot Air Drying' model. The model I purchased includes a hot air drying function, and fortunately, LG was running an internal promotion offering discounts on sink cabinet construction costs. Thanks to this, I was able to receive full support for the construction costs of standard cabinets, amounting to approximately 180,000 won! Construction costs for built-in installations can be quite a burden, so being able to install it at such a reasonable price made me feel like I had truly struck gold. 3. Sink renovation completed with skilled craftsmanship. The base cabinets in my sink were slightly larger than standard sizes, requiring cutting and reassembly. The technician, who visited around 10 AM, worked silently and single-handedly for over three hours, until 1:30 PM. I could feel the aura of a true craftsman watching him remove the large cabinets, precisely cut the materials, and reassemble them. It was also very convenient to be able to pay for the additional materials immediately on-site via card. 4. The epitome of meticulousness, a result with 200% satisfaction. Thanks to the technician, who remained kind and attentive until the very end despite working for such a long time, I felt great throughout the installation. When I looked at the kitchen after the work was finished, I was amazed at how cleanly the sink cabinet lines aligned; the finish was so beautiful and seamless, as if the dishwasher had been there from the very beginning. Since it was my first time using a dishwasher, I was half excited and half worried, but seeing it installed so perfectly makes me feel like my quality of life is going to skyrocket. I would like to express my gratitude once again to the technician for his meticulous and kind service. **Additional review:** I think it is quiet enough that the noise is barely noticeable. It runs smoothly on its own without interfering with daily life, and the pots and pans were washed until they were squeaky clean. If I don't use the hot air drying function, some moisture remains, but it is fine if I shake them out and let them air dry a bit more. I think I will use this very comfortably. If you are considering purchasing one, I strongly recommend choosing the LG dishwasher without hesitation!

It was also very convenient to be able to pay for the additional materials immediately on-site via card. 4. The epitome of meticulousness, a result with 200% satisfaction. Thanks to the technician, who remained kind and attentive until the very end despite working for such a long time, I felt great throughout the installation. I would like to express my gratitude once again to the technician for his meticulous and kind service. **Additional review:** I think it is quiet enough that the noise is barely noticeable. It runs smoothly on its own without interfering with daily life, and the pots and pans were washed until they were squeaky clean. If I don't use the hot air drying function, some moisture remains, but it is fine if I shake them out and let them air dry a bit more. I think I will use this very comfortably. If you are considering purchasing one, I strongly recommend choosing the LG dishwasher without hesitation!

I hadn't bought dishwasher detergent, so I couldn't test it right away. The technician ran the first wash cycle for me, and I was able to try the drying function. It is working perfectly without any issues. LG Objet Dishwasher Installation. Perfect from sink renovation to installation! It is natural to hesitate when buying a single appliance if the installation process is complicated, but this LG dishwasher installation was truly impressive. I am leaving this detailed review in the hopes it will be helpful to those who are buying a dishwasher for the first time like me, or those who are concerned about kitchen base cabinet renovations. 1. Meticulous pre-installation inspection and friendly guidance. The day before installation, the technician called to coordinate the visit time. Since my home is a built-in model, renovation of the sink base cabinets was essential. The technician carefully checked over the phone beforehand whether cabinet work was necessary and what the dimensions were, which put my mind at ease. Honestly, I was worried because I thought separate companies would need to come for the appliance installation and the furniture renovation. However, I felt very relieved to hear that the LG installation technician would personally handle everything from sink renovation to dishwasher installation in one go. 2. Construction cost benefits obtained by selecting the 'Hot Air Drying' model. The model I purchased includes a hot air drying function, and fortunately, LG was running an internal promotion offering discounts on sink cabinet construction costs. Thanks to this, I was able to receive full support for the construction costs of standard cabinets, amounting to approximately 180,000 won! Construction costs for built-in installations can be quite a burden, so being able to install it at such a reasonable price made me feel like I had truly struck gold. 3. Sink renovation completed with skilled craftsmanship. The base cabinets in my sink were slightly larger than standard sizes, requiring cutting and reassembly. The technician, who visited around 10 AM, worked silently and single-handedly for over three hours, until 1:30 PM. I could feel the aura of a true craftsman watching him remove the large cabinets, precisely cut the materials, and reassemble them. It was also very convenient to be able to pay for the additional materials immediately on-site via card. 4. The epitome of meticulousness, a result with 200% satisfaction. Thanks to the technician, who remained kind and attentive until the very end despite working for such a long time, I felt great throughout the installation. When I looked at the kitchen after the work was finished, I was amazed at how cleanly the sink cabinet lines aligned; the finish was so beautiful and seamless, as if the dishwasher had been there from the very beginning. Since it was my first time using a dishwasher, I was half excited and half worried, but seeing it installed so perfectly makes me feel like my quality of life is going to skyrocket. I would like to express my gratitude once again to the technician for his meticulous and kind service. **Additional review:** I think it is quiet enough that the noise is barely noticeable. It runs smoothly on its own without interfering with daily life, and the pots and pans were washed until they were squeaky clean. If I don't use the hot air drying function, some moisture remains, but it is fine if I shake them out and let them air dry a bit more. I think I will use this very comfortably. If you are considering purchasing one, I strongly recommend choosing the LG dishwasher without hesitation!

Sentence (English): DO NOT PURCHASE ANY APPLIANCE FROM LOWES!
Comments (English): [ Buyer beware! ] || ---------------- || DO NOT PURCHASE ANY APPLIANCE FROM LOWES! I purchased a Kitchen Aid Dishwasher online from Lowe's on February 16th. It stated that I could get delivery the following day. After order was complete it said that Lowe's would reach out to me for delivery times and a date. Lowe's sent a email stating that delivery had been set up for Feb 27 th and I would be notified the day prior with a 3 hour window. No call was made and so I waited all day until 5:30 when I received a text saying that they were on their way. A husband and wife arrived at my house in a SUV to deliver my dishwasher…. Like DoorDash! The dishwasher worked for 3 days before I experienced water coming from the base of the dishwasher. Called Lowe's and since they contract installation out they gave me the number to contact CRST who did the installation for them…This was on a Friday morning did not get a technician out until Monday afternoon. Again no call to let me know when this person would arrive. When I called for the 4 th time about when someone would be out they had no record of my calls! The technician came out he said the water issue was because the dishwasher itself was faulty. He said he would send a report to his company and then they would contact Lowe's and set something up with me to have someone else come out and inspect it. Then I would be charged $130 for a service fee since I didn't purchase this with my Lowe's card or buy the protection plan! Explaining that the machine is 3 days old and I have already paid for installation, parts , delivery and to haul the other one away. I paid $1200 for a dishwasher only to use it for 3 days and have waited almost a month to get a replacement! This has been a nightmare! I will NEVER buy another appliance from here! Beware!

Sentence (English): I was concerned about installation service, after reading the bad reviews here on Costco.com.
Comments (English): [ Clean dishes, great installation (L.A. area) ] || ---------------- || I was concerned about installation service, after reading the bad reviews here on Costco.com. But I can vouch that at least here in the L.A. area, the outsourced installers were professional, timely, and even worked around a tight squeeze we have with our cabinets/flooring.I'm also very pleased with the dishwasher itself. Our last dishwasher was a Bosch 300, which cleaned great, but the purge line kept getting jammed. When its control board died, I wanted a dishwasher with a hard food disposer. This one fit the bill, and it's been great so far. The non-pre-washed dishes get just as clean on a comparable wash setting, the purge line has stayed clear, and the bottle jets have come in handy for washing narrow necked bottles.Addressing some of the concerns others raised in their reviews: 1) Dishes do come out a bit wet. I was already in the habit of opening the door and racks, and letting them dry overnight with the Bosch, so it doesn't bother me, but it might bother you. 2) The third rack openings are big. Yup, sure are. Good for spatulas or other cookware, but not for small parts. 3) The upper rack's vertical clearance. It was definitely tight with the dishwasher-as-arrived-from-factory, but I moved the upper rack to the lower setting, and I can now fit a standard Nalgene bottle over the upper rack's bottle jets. A Stanley tumbler needs to go on the bottom, in the corner though.

The four bottom heavy-duty power sections are very useful, though you need the app to control all four zones instead of just front and back. Dishes are not dry when the cycle finishes so I usually run overnight; in the morning only a little moisture is left. The rack tines are mostly OK on the bottom, though a better scheme for larger pots, pans, mixing and serving bowls would be good. The silverware rack is OK though I can't lower it enough for large serving spoons without hitting the glasses below, but the middle rack for glasses does not work well for us. The rows of tines are close enough that we cannot put regular glasses in the right middle row, and the left middle row has "dips" that don't provide any useful purpose for us and just make that row unusable.

The one feature I wish they would have included in this particular model is an actual display of the time remaining on the door itself, like the 800 series. Looking forward to years of service with my new Bosch 300!

Sentence (English): This was my first time buying a dishwasher, so I don't have a clear comparison, but it was a successful purchase.
Comments (English): [ Successful purchase of my first dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This was my first time buying a dishwasher, so I don't have a clear comparison, but it was a successful purchase. It won't hold a ton of dishes or wash oversized frying pans and pots, but it's more than enough to handle a family of three's daily load. I was originally planning on purchasing a Samsung model, which also seats six people, but the installation guidelines required drilling holes and other restrictions. Since I'm renting, I don't want to bother drilling holes and I don't want to bother contacting the landlord, so I skipped drilling holes and just routed the water purifier under the cabinet. Midas was a brand I'd never heard of before, but I chose it for the following reasons: 1. The overall reviews were positive, and the flexible installation process required no drilling, depending on the situation. 2. Rumor has it that this brand also manufactures OEM products from major companies, meaning the product itself is not significantly different. 3. Despite this, the price was nearly 200,000 won cheaper. 4. Coupang offers two years of free after-sales service. What I liked about this model: 1. Simple and clean installation using a T-shaped attachment on the existing water purifier line. 2. Above all, it washes dishes cleanly, better than hand washing. 3. It's not very noisy, and the buttons are intuitive and easy to use. 4. The auto-open feature allows you to leave the dishwasher running while you go out or sleep. 5. The hot air drying function is also easy to turn on and off. 6. The design is clean and blends well with my white-toned kitchen. 7. The installer was friendly, and the installation was quick and accurate. I need to use it more to know for sure, but now, a few days after installation, I'm very satisfied. After dinner, there were so many dishes to clean up, sometimes it took nearly an hour just to clean them up, and my wrists and arms were sore, it was a relief. Most importantly, I now have more time and space to do other things while washing dishes. However, since the dishwasher runs for over two hours on the regular cycle, you need to play Tetris to load the dishes properly to avoid waste. And no matter how much you wash them with the dishwasher, it's a good idea to rinse them thoroughly with water before putting them back in. Sentence (English): Our last 3 dishwashers have been KitchenAid and prior to this purchase, I sang their praises anytime someone asked for a recommendation.
Comments (English): [ Do Not Buy This Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Our last 3 dishwashers have been KitchenAid and prior to this purchase, I sang their praises anytime someone asked for a recommendation. This time, however, I'm unbelievably disappointed in the quality of the of the product, the handling of the warranty, and the after-sales support from their authorized support via a third party. Our dishwasher has been installed for less than 4 months and was operating perfectly, then a few weeks ago it started to pause in the middle of a cycle. Initially, it only happened once per cycle, but soon after we had to make a habit of checking the dishwasher every so often to make sure it hadn't paused. We also noticed that the screen/power would shut off intermittently when we were opening or closing the door, which seemed odd, but it would turn back on eventually. We decided to put in a support ticket with KitchenAid. Since this dishwasher is so new, it's supposed to be completely covered under warranty. KitchenAid scheduled a third party to come out and perform a diagnosis. During this visit, I had the strangest interaction I've ever had with a contractor. He parked his car in front of my driveway on the road with it still running and the hazards on, then came inside and sat down on the floor cross-legged and repeatedly opened and closed the dishwasher, pressing a few buttons here and there, not saying a word. He then concluded confidently that the latch had gone bad and it would be 7-10 days until we got the part. I pushed back saying that I didn't think the power should be shutting off related to the latch. He brushed me off suggesting I didn't know what I was talking about. A few days later, the unit is non-responsive; it is clear there's a wiring issue because the display will flicker on for a moment and then shut off again depending on the door's position. And as of this week, there is now no power to the display, we can't do anything to drain the water that has been in the unit for weeks, so we reached out to the third party company again. They ignored several emails and voicemails from us saying we didn't think it was the latch—we finally received word from them that the latch part was in and they scheduled another visit, but didn't show up. We called them and they said the part hadn't arrived. We then got a call back that it had actually arrived but they couldn't send anyone out for another week. Our dishwasher has now been filled with nasty water for nearly a month because we can't drain it since the power isn't working, and the technician who performed the diagnostics is working on the wrong solution. At this point, I'm disappointed in the initial build quality of the unit, the selection of the third party by KitchenAid, and the handling of the warranty claims. This unit is far too expensive to fail within 4 months and not have adequate, expeditious support. I will not be buying a KitchenAid dishwasher in the future and I suggest you think long and hard before you do too.

Sentence (English): Since this was my first time buying a dishwasher, I don't have a specific point of comparison, but it was a successful purchase.
Comments (English): [ First dishwasher purchase successful ] || ---------------- || Since this was my first time buying a dishwasher, I don't have a specific point of comparison, but it was a successful purchase. While it might be difficult to load a huge number of dishes or wash very large frying pans and pots, I think the size is more than sufficient for washing a day's worth of dishes for a family of three. I originally planned to buy a Samsung product of the same 6-place setting, but when I looked at the installation guidelines, there were many restrictions, such as the requirement to drill holes unconditionally. Since I live in a rented apartment, I wasn't keen on drilling holes or contacting the landlord, which is why I even run my water purifier line under the base cabinet without drilling. Although Midas is a brand I hadn't seen before, I chose it for the following reasons: 1. The reviews are generally good, and installation is flexible and can be done without drilling depending on the situation. 2. There is a rumor that this brand manufactures products from major corporations via OEM, meaning there isn't a significant difference in the product itself. 3. Despite this, the price is nearly 200,000 won cheaper. 4. Coupang provides 2 years of free after-sales service. And what I was satisfied with: 1. Simple and neat installation using a T-connector on the existing water purifier line. 2. Above all, it cleans even better than hand washing, leaving dishes squeaky clean. 3. The noise isn't too loud, and the buttons are intuitive and easy to operate. 4. With the automatic door opening function, you can leave the dishwasher running while you go out or sleep. 5. The hot air drying function can also be easily set and deactivated. 6. The design is clean and blends well with a white-toned kitchen. 7. The technician was kind, and the installation was fast and accurate. I still need to use it more to know for sure, but now, a few days after installation, I am using it with great satisfaction. After preparing dinner, there used to be a huge pile of dishes; sometimes it would take nearly an hour just to clean up, and my wrists and arms would ache, making it a real struggle. But now I am free from that. Most importantly, the biggest benefit is that I now have the time and leisure to do other things instead of washing dishes. However, since the dishwasher runs for over 2 hours on the standard cycle, you need to be good at Tetris to pack the dishes neatly to use it without wasting them. Also, even though you are using the dishwasher, it is best to rinse the dishes with water once before putting them in. It wouldn't be nice if they came out uncleaned after running it for such a long time, right? I originally planned to buy a Samsung product of the same 6-place setting, but when I looked at the installation guidelines, there were many restrictions, such as the requirement to drill holes unconditionally. Since I live in a rented apartment, I wasn't keen on drilling holes or contacting the landlord, which is why I even run my water purifier line under the base cabinet without drilling. Although Midas is a brand I hadn't seen before, I chose it for the following reasons: 1. The reviews are generally good, and installation is flexible and can be done without drilling depending on the situation. 2. There is a rumor that this brand manufactures products from major corporations via OEM, meaning there isn't a significant difference in the product itself. 3. Despite this, the price is nearly 200,000 won cheaper. 4. Coupang provides 2 years of free after-sales service. And what I was satisfied with: 1. But now I am free from that. Most importantly, the biggest benefit is that I now have the time and leisure to do other things instead of washing dishes. However, since the dishwasher runs for over 2 hours on the standard cycle, you need to be good at Tetris to pack the dishes neatly to use it without wasting them. Also, even though you are using the dishwasher, it is best to rinse the dishes with water once before putting them in. It wouldn't be nice if they came out uncleaned after running it for such a long time, right? Also, since you eventually have to remove the strainer to clean food residue, I think at least some minimal labor is necessary for maintenance. In conclusion, the dishwasher is the best. I'm glad I bought it.

I'm glad I bought it.

Comments (English): [ First dishwasher purchase successful ] || ---------------- || Since this was my first time buying a dishwasher, I don't have a specific point of comparison, but it was a successful purchase. While it might be difficult to load a huge number of dishes or wash very large frying pans and pots, I think the size is more than sufficient for washing a day's worth of dishes for a family of three. I originally planned to buy a Samsung product of the same 6-place setting, but when I looked at the installation guidelines, there were many restrictions, such as the requirement to drill holes unconditionally. Since I live in a rented apartment, I wasn't keen on drilling holes or contacting the landlord, which is why I even run my water purifier line under the base cabinet without drilling. Although Midas is a brand I hadn't seen before, I chose it for the following reasons: 1. The reviews are generally good, and installation is flexible and can be done without drilling depending on the situation. 2. There is a rumor that this brand manufactures products from major corporations via OEM, meaning there isn't a significant difference in the product itself. 3. Despite this, the price is nearly 200,000 won cheaper. 4. Coupang provides 2 years of free after-sales service. And what I was satisfied with: 1. Simple and neat installation using a T-connector on the existing water purifier line. 2. Above all, it cleans even better than hand washing, leaving dishes squeaky clean. 3. The noise isn't too loud, and the buttons are intuitive and easy to operate. 4. With the automatic door opening function, you can leave the dishwasher running while you go out or sleep. 5. The hot air drying function can also be easily set and deactivated. 6. The design is clean and blends well with a white-toned kitchen. 7. The technician was kind, and the installation was fast and accurate. I still need to use it more to know for sure, but now, a few days after installation, I am using it with great satisfaction. After preparing dinner, there used to be a huge pile of dishes; sometimes it would take nearly an hour just to clean up, and my wrists and arms would ache, making it a real struggle. But now I am free from that. Most importantly, the biggest benefit is that I now have the time and leisure to do other things instead of washing dishes. However, since the dishwasher runs for over 2 hours on the standard cycle, you need to be good at Tetris to pack the dishes neatly to use it without wasting them. Also, even though you are using the dishwasher, it is best to rinse the dishes with water once before putting them in. It wouldn't be nice if they came out uncleaned after running it for such a long time, right? Also, since you eventually have to remove the strainer to clean food residue, I think at least some minimal labor is necessary for maintenance. In conclusion, the dishwasher is the best. I'm glad I bought it.

I'm glad I bought it.

Sentence (English): I regret buying this dishwasher with every soapy fiber of my being.
Comments (English): [ The Loudest, Wettest Regret in My Kitchen ] || ---------------- || I regret buying this dishwasher with every soapy fiber of my being. If regret had a sound, it would be this machine running in my kitchen.The quality is impressively terrible. The bottom rack doesn't even have a real track for the wheels. None. Zero. So every time you pull it out, it tries to escape the dishwasher like it's making a break for freedom and just falls off the door.It also claims to have a drying cycle, which is adorable. In reality, it just lightly warms your dishes and then leaves them soaking wet, so you can enjoy the bonus activity of air-drying everything yourself. Apparently, this dishwasher believes in personal growth and wants you to stay involved in the process.The noise level is wild. When it's running, my TV and I are now in a volume arms race. I've started waiting until bedtime to turn it on, so I don't have to listen to it sound like it's washing dishes with a bucket of rocks.To be fair, it does have three functions and only one button, so I gave the "ease of use" two stars. Not because it deserves them, but because it is technically difficult to mess up pressing one button.The real punchline is that after the dishwasher, delivery, and installation, I spent over $700. Seven hundred dollars for a machine that feels like it was designed during someone's lunch break.If you enjoy wet dishes, runaway racks, and a soundtrack of industrial noise in your kitchen, this is the dishwasher for you.Everyone else: save your money and buy literally anything else.

Sentence (English): To be honest, when I first got the dishwasher, I had a standard white model in my cart, looking solely at its value for money.
Comments (English): [ A reasonable dishwasher that captures both function and design at a great price. ] || ---------------- || To be honest, when I first got the dishwasher, I had a standard white model in my cart, looking solely at its value for money. It was a model that lacked features like hot air and the auto-open door, but at around 720,000 won, it was quite attractive. I wasn't particularly interested in the hot air feature because of concerns about high electricity consumption and rumors that it could melt plastic containers; however, the issue was the design. The simple exterior, Cotta White color, and glass finish of the auto-open door model kept catching my eye. In the end, the moment it appeared on Coupang as a special offer for 960,000 won, I bought it immediately and canceled my previous order. Since I saved over 100,000 won from the original price, I was satisfied even with the short installment period. As it was a direct delivery from Samsung, a technician came in person to handle the installation. They installed it very meticulously and kindly explained the functions afterward, making it easy for even a first-time user to adapt. After actually using it following installation, I could definitely see that the new model had many advantages. The cleaning performance was fundamentally stable, and the variety of cycles allowed me to choose the one that best suited the situation, which was convenient. Above all, the automatic door opening feature, which my old model didn't have, was extremely useful. Once the wash is finished, the door opens automatically to allow internal moisture to escape, which helps dishes dry more thoroughly and leaves fewer odors. I used a first-generation model before that, so it didn't have this feature. Although most models nowadays have it, after using it myself, I found the cleaning power to be stable and it operates quietly, allowing me to run it at night without worry. The Auto-Open Door function opens the door with a light push. It wasn't a revolutionary feature that immediately stood out, but it gave off a sophisticated vibe. Also, if you were to open it by grabbing the handle like before, you might feel a sense of reverse. This feature makes a significant difference aesthetically as well. As expected, the design was satisfying. The Cota White color and glass finish blend well with my newly decorated interior, making the kitchen atmosphere much more sophisticated. Being built-in, it maximizes space, and the clean exterior gives the entire kitchen a neat and organized feel. I initially hesitated simply because of the price, but ultimately, I am very satisfied with this choice as it secured both design and functionality.
Comments (Original): [ 기능과 디자인 모두 챙기고 가격까지 좋은 합리적 식세기 ] || ---------------- || 식기세척기는 사실 처음엔 가성비만 보고 일반 화이트 모델을 장바구니에 담아둔 상태였어요. 열풍이나 오토오픈도어 기능이 빠진 모델이었는데, 가격이 72만 원 정도라 꽤 매력적이었죠. 열풍은 전기를 많이 쓴다는 얘기도 있고, 플라스틱 용기가 녹는다는 소문도 있어서 크게 관심이 없었는데, 문제는 디자인이었습니다. 오토오픈도어 모델의 심플한 외관과 코타화이트 컬러, 글라스 마감이 계속 눈에 밟히더라고요. 결국 쿠팡에서 특가로 96만 원에 뜨는 순간 바로 구매하고 기존 제품은 취소했습니다. 본래 가격보다 10만 원 이상 저렴하게 산 거라 할부 기간이 짧아도 만족스러웠습니다.설치 과정은 삼성 직배송이라 기사님이 직접 오셔서 진행했는데, 굉장히 세심하게 설치해주신 뒤 다 끝나고 친절하게 기능 설명을 해주셔서 처음 쓰는 사람도 어렵지 않게 적응할 수 있었습니다. 설치 후 실제로 사용해보니 확실히 신모델이라 좋은 점이 많았습니다. 세척력은 기본적으로 안정적이고, 다양한 코스가 있어서 상황에 맞게 선택할 수 있는 점이 편리했습니다. 무엇보다 원래 쓰던 제품에는 없던 자동문열림이 아주 유용했어요. 세척이 끝나면 자동으로 문이 열리면서 내부 습기가 빠져나가는데, 덕분에 식기가 더 뽀송하게 마르고 냄새도 덜 남습니다. 그전엔 1세대 제품 써서 이 기능이 없었거든요. 요즘은 웬만하면 다 있지만요ㅎㅎ 직접 써보니 세척력은 안정적이고 조용하게 작동해서 밤에도 부담 없이 돌릴 수 있었습니다. 오토오픈도어 기능은 살짝 누르듯이 설치하면 문이 열리는 기능인데요. 크게 와닿는 수준의 혁신적인 기능은 아니었지만, 뭔가 있어보이는 느낌?ㅎㅎ 그리고 기존처럼 손잡이 잡고 열고 그러면 역체감이 느껴질 수도 있을 것 같아요. 미관적으로도 이 기능 덕분에 큰 차이가 나고요.디자인은 역시 기대했던 대로 만족스러웠습니다. 코타화이트 컬러와 글라스 마감이 새로 꾸민 인테리어와 잘 어울려서 주방 분위기를 한층 세련되게 만들어줍니다. 빌트인이라 공간 활용도 좋고, 외관이 깔끔해서 주방 전체가 정돈된 느낌을 줍니다. 처음엔 단순히 가격 때문에 고민했지만, 결과적으로는 디자인과 기능 모두 챙긴 선택이 되어 만족도가 큽니다.

Comments (English): [ A reasonable dishwasher that captures both function and design at a great price. ] || ---------------- || To be honest, when I first got the dishwasher, I had a standard white model in my cart, looking solely at its value for money. I wasn't particularly interested in the hot air feature because of concerns about high electricity consumption and rumors that it could melt plastic containers; however, the issue was the design. The simple exterior, Cotta White color, and glass finish of the auto-open door model kept catching my eye. In the end, the moment it appeared on Coupang as a special offer for 960,000 won, I bought it immediately and canceled my previous order. Since I saved over 100,000 won from the original price, I was satisfied even with the short installment period. As it was a direct delivery from Samsung, a technician came in person to handle the installation. They installed it very meticulously and kindly explained the functions afterward, making it easy for even a first-time user to adapt. After actually using it following installation, I could definitely see that the new model had many advantages. The cleaning performance was fundamentally stable, and the variety of cycles allowed me to choose the one that best suited the situation, which was convenient. Above all, the automatic door opening feature, which my old model didn't have, was extremely useful. Once the wash is finished, the door opens automatically to allow internal moisture to escape, which helps dishes dry more thoroughly and leaves fewer odors. I used a first-generation model before that, so it didn't have this feature. Although most models nowadays have it, after using it myself, I found the cleaning power to be stable and it operates quietly, allowing me to run it at night without worry. The Auto-Open Door function opens the door with a light push. It wasn't a revolutionary feature that immediately stood out, but it gave off a sophisticated vibe. Also, if you were to open it by grabbing the handle like before, you might feel a sense of reverse. This feature makes a significant difference aesthetically as well. As expected, the design was satisfying. The Cota White color and glass finish blend well with my newly decorated interior, making the kitchen atmosphere much more sophisticated. Being built-in, it maximizes space, and the clean exterior gives the entire kitchen a neat and organized feel. I initially hesitated simply because of the price, but ultimately, I am very satisfied with this choice as it secured both design and functionality.

Sentence (English): Since I saved over 100,000 won from the original price, I was satisfied even with the short installment period.
Comments (English): [ A reasonable dishwasher that captures both function and design at a great price. ] || ---------------- || To be honest, when I first got the dishwasher, I had a standard white model in my cart, looking solely at its value for money. It was a model that lacked features like hot air and the auto-open door, but at around 720,000 won, it was quite attractive. I wasn't particularly interested in the hot air feature because of concerns about high electricity consumption and rumors that it could melt plastic containers; however, the issue was the design. The simple exterior, Cotta White color, and glass finish of the auto-open door model kept catching my eye. In the end, the moment it appeared on Coupang as a special offer for 960,000 won, I bought it immediately and canceled my previous order. Since I saved over 100,000 won from the original price, I was satisfied even with the short installment period. As it was a direct delivery from Samsung, a technician came in person to handle the installation. They installed it very meticulously and kindly explained the functions afterward, making it easy for even a first-time user to adapt. After actually using it following installation, I could definitely see that the new model had many advantages. The cleaning performance was fundamentally stable, and the variety of cycles allowed me to choose the one that best suited the situation, which was convenient. Above all, the automatic door opening feature, which my old model didn't have, was extremely useful. Once the wash is finished, the door opens automatically to allow internal moisture to escape, which helps dishes dry more thoroughly and leaves fewer odors. I used a first-generation model before that, so it didn't have this feature. Although most models nowadays have it, after using it myself, I found the cleaning power to be stable and it operates quietly, allowing me to run it at night without worry. The Auto-Open Door function opens the door with a light push. It wasn't a revolutionary feature that immediately stood out, but it gave off a sophisticated vibe. Also, if you were to open it by grabbing the handle like before, you might feel a sense of reverse. This feature makes a significant difference aesthetically as well. As expected, the design was satisfying. The Cota White color and glass finish blend well with my newly decorated interior, making the kitchen atmosphere much more sophisticated. Being built-in, it maximizes space, and the clean exterior gives the entire kitchen a neat and organized feel. I initially hesitated simply because of the price, but ultimately, I am very satisfied with this choice as it secured both design and functionality.

I initially hesitated simply because of the price, but ultimately, I am very satisfied with this choice as it secured both design and functionality.

Comments (English): [ A reasonable dishwasher that captures both function and design at a great price. ] || ---------------- || To be honest, when I first got the dishwasher, I had a standard white model in my cart, looking solely at its value for money. It was a model that lacked features like hot air and the auto-open door, but at around 720,000 won, it was quite attractive. I wasn't particularly interested in the hot air feature because of concerns about high electricity consumption and rumors that it could melt plastic containers; however, the issue was the design. The simple exterior, Cotta White color, and glass finish of the auto-open door model kept catching my eye. In the end, the moment it appeared on Coupang as a special offer for 960,000 won, I bought it immediately and canceled my previous order. Since I saved over 100,000 won from the original price, I was satisfied even with the short installment period. As it was a direct delivery from Samsung, a technician came in person to handle the installation. They installed it very meticulously and kindly explained the functions afterward, making it easy for even a first-time user to adapt. After actually using it following installation, I could definitely see that the new model had many advantages. The cleaning performance was fundamentally stable, and the variety of cycles allowed me to choose the one that best suited the situation, which was convenient. Above all, the automatic door opening feature, which my old model didn't have, was extremely useful. Once the wash is finished, the door opens automatically to allow internal moisture to escape, which helps dishes dry more thoroughly and leaves fewer odors. I used a first-generation model before that, so it didn't have this feature. Although most models nowadays have it, after using it myself, I found the cleaning power to be stable and it operates quietly, allowing me to run it at night without worry. The Auto-Open Door function opens the door with a light push. It wasn't a revolutionary feature that immediately stood out, but it gave off a sophisticated vibe. Also, if you were to open it by grabbing the handle like before, you might feel a sense of reverse. This feature makes a significant difference aesthetically as well. As expected, the design was satisfying. The Cota White color and glass finish blend well with my newly decorated interior, making the kitchen atmosphere much more sophisticated. Being built-in, it maximizes space, and the clean exterior gives the entire kitchen a neat and organized feel. I initially hesitated simply because of the price, but ultimately, I am very satisfied with this choice as it secured both design and functionality.

Comments (English): [ A reasonable dishwasher that captures both function and design at a great price. ] || ---------------- || To be honest, when I first got the dishwasher, I had a standard white model in my cart, looking solely at its value for money. It was a model that lacked features like hot air and the auto-open door, but at around 720,000 won, it was quite attractive. I wasn't particularly interested in the hot air feature because of concerns about high electricity consumption and rumors that it could melt plastic containers; however, the issue was the design. The simple exterior, Cotta White color, and glass finish of the auto-open door model kept catching my eye. In the end, the moment it appeared on Coupang as a special offer for 960,000 won, I bought it immediately and canceled my previous order. Since I saved over 100,000 won from the original price, I was satisfied even with the short installment period. As it was a direct delivery from Samsung, a technician came in person to handle the installation. They installed it very meticulously and kindly explained the functions afterward, making it easy for even a first-time user to adapt. After actually using it following installation, I could definitely see that the new model had many advantages. The cleaning performance was fundamentally stable, and the variety of cycles allowed me to choose the one that best suited the situation, which was convenient. Above all, the automatic door opening feature, which my old model didn't have, was extremely useful. Once the wash is finished, the door opens automatically to allow internal moisture to escape, which helps dishes dry more thoroughly and leaves fewer odors. I used a first-generation model before that, so it didn't have this feature. Although most models nowadays have it, after using it myself, I found the cleaning power to be stable and it operates quietly, allowing me to run it at night without worry. The Auto-Open Door function opens the door with a light push. It wasn't a revolutionary feature that immediately stood out, but it gave off a sophisticated vibe. Also, if you were to open it by grabbing the handle like before, you might feel a sense of reverse. This feature makes a significant difference aesthetically as well. As expected, the design was satisfying. The Cota White color and glass finish blend well with my newly decorated interior, making the kitchen atmosphere much more sophisticated. Being built-in, it maximizes space, and the clean exterior gives the entire kitchen a neat and organized feel. I initially hesitated simply because of the price, but ultimately, I am very satisfied with this choice as it secured both design and functionality.

Sentence (English): As expected, the design was satisfying.
Comments (English): [ A reasonable dishwasher that captures both function and design at a great price. ] || ---------------- || To be honest, when I first got the dishwasher, I had a standard white model in my cart, looking solely at its value for money. It was a model that lacked features like hot air and the auto-open door, but at around 720,000 won, it was quite attractive. I wasn't particularly interested in the hot air feature because of concerns about high electricity consumption and rumors that it could melt plastic containers; however, the issue was the design. The simple exterior, Cotta White color, and glass finish of the auto-open door model kept catching my eye. In the end, the moment it appeared on Coupang as a special offer for 960,000 won, I bought it immediately and canceled my previous order. Since I saved over 100,000 won from the original price, I was satisfied even with the short installment period. As it was a direct delivery from Samsung, a technician came in person to handle the installation. They installed it very meticulously and kindly explained the functions afterward, making it easy for even a first-time user to adapt. After actually using it following installation, I could definitely see that the new model had many advantages. The cleaning performance was fundamentally stable, and the variety of cycles allowed me to choose the one that best suited the situation, which was convenient. Above all, the automatic door opening feature, which my old model didn't have, was extremely useful. Once the wash is finished, the door opens automatically to allow internal moisture to escape, which helps dishes dry more thoroughly and leaves fewer odors. I used a first-generation model before that, so it didn't have this feature. Although most models nowadays have it, after using it myself, I found the cleaning power to be stable and it operates quietly, allowing me to run it at night without worry. The Auto-Open Door function opens the door with a light push. It wasn't a revolutionary feature that immediately stood out, but it gave off a sophisticated vibe. Also, if you were to open it by grabbing the handle like before, you might feel a sense of reverse. This feature makes a significant difference aesthetically as well. As expected, the design was satisfying. The Cota White color and glass finish blend well with my newly decorated interior, making the kitchen atmosphere much more sophisticated. Being built-in, it maximizes space, and the clean exterior gives the entire kitchen a neat and organized feel. I initially hesitated simply because of the price, but ultimately, I am very satisfied with this choice as it secured both design and functionality.

Comments (English): [ First dishwasher purchase successful ] || ---------------- || April 15, 2026. One-month usage review. I mainly use the Power Mode (89 minutes), which has a relatively short run time. What I am most satisfied with is cleaning plastic containers. When putting side dishes in plastic containers, no matter how thoroughly you wash them by hand, they are bound to feel slippery or have an odor. However, perhaps because it is hot-air dried after washing in the dishwasher, they feel squeaky clean and leave no smell! However, for plastic containers that are not made of hard materials like Tritan, deformation may occur, so I recommend using a mode other than Power Mode. Since the dishwasher runs for a while, washing by hand is obviously faster considering the amount of dishes, but I think the reason for using a dishwasher is that it drastically reduces that labor and time. I am so satisfied that I feel it would be hard to go back to the days without one! -----------. Since this is my first time buying a dishwasher, I don't have a specific point of comparison, but it was a successful purchase. It might be difficult to put in a huge number of dishes or wash very large frying pans and pots, but I think the size is more than sufficient for washing a day's worth of dishes for a family of three. I originally intended to purchase a Samsung product of the same 6-place setting, but when I looked at the installation guidelines, there were many restrictions, such as the requirement to drill holes unconditionally. Since I live in a rented apartment, I wasn't keen on drilling holes haphazardly, and I didn't want to bother contacting the landlord; that is why I even run my water purifier by routing the cable under the base cabinet without drilling. Although Midas is a brand I hadn't seen before, I chose it for the following reasons: 1. The reviews are generally positive, and installation is flexible and can be done without drilling depending on the situation. 2. There is a rumor that this brand manufactures products from major corporations via OEM, meaning there is no significant difference in the product itself. 3. Despite this, the price is nearly 200,000 won cheaper. 4. Coupang provides 2 years of free after-sales service. And here are the things I was satisfied with: 1. Simple and neat installation using a T-connector on the existing water purifier cable. 2. Most importantly, it cleans dishes even better than hand washing, leaving them squeaky clean. 3. The noise isn't too loud, and the buttons are intuitive and easy to operate. 4. With the automatic door opening feature, I can leave the dishwasher running while I go out or sleep. 5. The hot air drying function can also be easily set and deactivated. 6. The design is clean and blends well with my white-toned kitchen. 7. The technician was kind, and the installation was fast and accurate. I still need to use it more to know for sure, but now that it has been a few days since installation, I am using it with great satisfaction. After preparing dinner, there used to be a huge pile of dishes; sometimes it would take nearly an hour just to clean up, and my wrists and arms would ache, making it a real struggle. But now I am free from that burden. Most importantly, the biggest advantage is that I now have the time and leisure to do other things instead of washing dishes. However, since the dishwasher runs for over two hours on the standard cycle, you need to be good at Tetris to pack the dishes neatly to use it without wasting them. Also, even if you are using the dishwasher to clean, it is best to rinse the dishes with water once before putting them in. It would be a shame to run it for a long time only to find they aren't clean enough, right? Sentence (English): One-month usage review.
Comments (English): [ First dishwasher purchase successful ] || ---------------- || April 15, 2026. One-month usage review. I mainly use the Power Mode (89 minutes), which has a relatively short run time. What I am most satisfied with is cleaning plastic containers. When putting side dishes in plastic containers, no matter how thoroughly you wash them by hand, they are bound to feel slippery or have an odor. However, perhaps because it is hot-air dried after washing in the dishwasher, they feel squeaky clean and leave no smell! However, for plastic containers that are not made of hard materials like Tritan, deformation may occur, so I recommend using a mode other than Power Mode. Since the dishwasher runs for a while, washing by hand is obviously faster considering the amount of dishes, but I think the reason for using a dishwasher is that it drastically reduces that labor and time. I am so satisfied that I feel it would be hard to go back to the days without one! -----------. Since this is my first time buying a dishwasher, I don't have a specific point of comparison, but it was a successful purchase. It might be difficult to put in a huge number of dishes or wash very large frying pans and pots, but I think the size is more than sufficient for washing a day's worth of dishes for a family of three. I originally intended to purchase a Samsung product of the same 6-place setting, but when I looked at the installation guidelines, there were many restrictions, such as the requirement to drill holes unconditionally. Since I live in a rented apartment, I wasn't keen on drilling holes haphazardly, and I didn't want to bother contacting the landlord; that is why I even run my water purifier by routing the cable under the base cabinet without drilling. Although Midas is a brand I hadn't seen before, I chose it for the following reasons: 1. The reviews are generally positive, and installation is flexible and can be done without drilling depending on the situation. 2. There is a rumor that this brand manufactures products from major corporations via OEM, meaning there is no significant difference in the product itself. 3. Despite this, the price is nearly 200,000 won cheaper. 4. Coupang provides 2 years of free after-sales service. And here are the things I was satisfied with: 1. Simple and neat installation using a T-connector on the existing water purifier cable. 2. Most importantly, it cleans dishes even better than hand washing, leaving them squeaky clean. 3. The noise isn't too loud, and the buttons are intuitive and easy to operate. 4. With the automatic door opening feature, I can leave the dishwasher running while I go out or sleep. 5. The hot air drying function can also be easily set and deactivated. 6. The design is clean and blends well with my white-toned kitchen. 7. The technician was kind, and the installation was fast and accurate. I still need to use it more to know for sure, but now that it has been a few days since installation, I am using it with great satisfaction. After preparing dinner, there used to be a huge pile of dishes; sometimes it would take nearly an hour just to clean up, and my wrists and arms would ache, making it a real struggle. But now I am free from that burden. Most importantly, the biggest advantage is that I now have the time and leisure to do other things instead of washing dishes. However, since the dishwasher runs for over two hours on the standard cycle, you need to be good at Tetris to pack the dishes neatly to use it without wasting them. Also, even if you are using the dishwasher to clean, it is best to rinse the dishes with water once before putting them in. It would be a shame to run it for a long time only to find they aren't clean enough, right? Furthermore, since you eventually have to remove the strainer to clean food residue, I think a minimum amount of labor is necessary for maintenance purposes as well. In conclusion, this dishwasher is the best. I made the right purchase.

Sentence (English): What I am most satisfied with is cleaning plastic containers.
Comments (English): [ First dishwasher purchase successful ] || ---------------- || April 15, 2026. One-month usage review. I mainly use the Power Mode (89 minutes), which has a relatively short run time. What I am most satisfied with is cleaning plastic containers. When putting side dishes in plastic containers, no matter how thoroughly you wash them by hand, they are bound to feel slippery or have an odor. However, perhaps because it is hot-air dried after washing in the dishwasher, they feel squeaky clean and leave no smell! However, for plastic containers that are not made of hard materials like Tritan, deformation may occur, so I recommend using a mode other than Power Mode. Since the dishwasher runs for a while, washing by hand is obviously faster considering the amount of dishes, but I think the reason for using a dishwasher is that it drastically reduces that labor and time. I am so satisfied that I feel it would be hard to go back to the days without one! -----------. Since this is my first time buying a dishwasher, I don't have a specific point of comparison, but it was a successful purchase. It might be difficult to put in a huge number of dishes or wash very large frying pans and pots, but I think the size is more than sufficient for washing a day's worth of dishes for a family of three. I originally intended to purchase a Samsung product of the same 6-place setting, but when I looked at the installation guidelines, there were many restrictions, such as the requirement to drill holes unconditionally. Since I live in a rented apartment, I wasn't keen on drilling holes haphazardly, and I didn't want to bother contacting the landlord; that is why I even run my water purifier by routing the cable under the base cabinet without drilling. Although Midas is a brand I hadn't seen before, I chose it for the following reasons: 1. The reviews are generally positive, and installation is flexible and can be done without drilling depending on the situation. 2. There is a rumor that this brand manufactures products from major corporations via OEM, meaning there is no significant difference in the product itself. 3. Despite this, the price is nearly 200,000 won cheaper. 4. Coupang provides 2 years of free after-sales service. And here are the things I was satisfied with: 1. Simple and neat installation using a T-connector on the existing water purifier cable. 2. Most importantly, it cleans dishes even better than hand washing, leaving them squeaky clean. 3. The noise isn't too loud, and the buttons are intuitive and easy to operate. 4. With the automatic door opening feature, I can leave the dishwasher running while I go out or sleep. 5. The hot air drying function can also be easily set and deactivated. 6. The design is clean and blends well with my white-toned kitchen. 7. The technician was kind, and the installation was fast and accurate. I still need to use it more to know for sure, but now that it has been a few days since installation, I am using it with great satisfaction. After preparing dinner, there used to be a huge pile of dishes; sometimes it would take nearly an hour just to clean up, and my wrists and arms would ache, making it a real struggle. But now I am free from that burden. Most importantly, the biggest advantage is that I now have the time and leisure to do other things instead of washing dishes. However, since the dishwasher runs for over two hours on the standard cycle, you need to be good at Tetris to pack the dishes neatly to use it without wasting them. Also, even if you are using the dishwasher to clean, it is best to rinse the dishes with water once before putting them in. It would be a shame to run it for a long time only to find they aren't clean enough, right? Furthermore, since you eventually have to remove the strainer to clean food residue, I think a minimum amount of labor is necessary for maintenance purposes as well. In conclusion, this dishwasher is the best. I made the right purchase.

Sentence (English): However, perhaps because it is hot-air dried after washing in the dishwasher, they feel squeaky clean and leave no smell!
Comments (English): [ First dishwasher purchase successful ] || ---------------- || April 15, 2026. One-month usage review. I mainly use the Power Mode (89 minutes), which has a relatively short run time. What I am most satisfied with is cleaning plastic containers. When putting side dishes in plastic containers, no matter how thoroughly you wash them by hand, they are bound to feel slippery or have an odor. However, perhaps because it is hot-air dried after washing in the dishwasher, they feel squeaky clean and leave no smell! However, for plastic containers that are not made of hard materials like Tritan, deformation may occur, so I recommend using a mode other than Power Mode. Since the dishwasher runs for a while, washing by hand is obviously faster considering the amount of dishes, but I think the reason for using a dishwasher is that it drastically reduces that labor and time. I am so satisfied that I feel it would be hard to go back to the days without one! -----------. Since this is my first time buying a dishwasher, I don't have a specific point of comparison, but it was a successful purchase. It might be difficult to put in a huge number of dishes or wash very large frying pans and pots, but I think the size is more than sufficient for washing a day's worth of dishes for a family of three. I originally intended to purchase a Samsung product of the same 6-place setting, but when I looked at the installation guidelines, there were many restrictions, such as the requirement to drill holes unconditionally. Since I live in a rented apartment, I wasn't keen on drilling holes haphazardly, and I didn't want to bother contacting the landlord; that is why I even run my water purifier by routing the cable under the base cabinet without drilling. Although Midas is a brand I hadn't seen before, I chose it for the following reasons: 1. The reviews are generally positive, and installation is flexible and can be done without drilling depending on the situation. 2. There is a rumor that this brand manufactures products from major corporations via OEM, meaning there is no significant difference in the product itself. 3. Despite this, the price is nearly 200,000 won cheaper. 4. Coupang provides 2 years of free after-sales service. And here are the things I was satisfied with: 1. Simple and neat installation using a T-connector on the existing water purifier cable. 2. Most importantly, it cleans dishes even better than hand washing, leaving them squeaky clean. 3. The noise isn't too loud, and the buttons are intuitive and easy to operate. 4. With the automatic door opening feature, I can leave the dishwasher running while I go out or sleep. 5. The hot air drying function can also be easily set and deactivated. 6. The design is clean and blends well with my white-toned kitchen. 7. The technician was kind, and the installation was fast and accurate. I still need to use it more to know for sure, but now that it has been a few days since installation, I am using it with great satisfaction. After preparing dinner, there used to be a huge pile of dishes; sometimes it would take nearly an hour just to clean up, and my wrists and arms would ache, making it a real struggle. But now I am free from that burden. Most importantly, the biggest advantage is that I now have the time and leisure to do other things instead of washing dishes. However, since the dishwasher runs for over two hours on the standard cycle, you need to be good at Tetris to pack the dishes neatly to use it without wasting them. Also, even if you are using the dishwasher to clean, it is best to rinse the dishes with water once before putting them in. It would be a shame to run it for a long time only to find they aren't clean enough, right? Furthermore, since you eventually have to remove the strainer to clean food residue, I think a minimum amount of labor is necessary for maintenance purposes as well. In conclusion, this dishwasher is the best. I made the right purchase.

Comments (English): [ First dishwasher purchase successful ] || ---------------- || April 15, 2026. One-month usage review. I mainly use the Power Mode (89 minutes), which has a relatively short run time. What I am most satisfied with is cleaning plastic containers. When putting side dishes in plastic containers, no matter how thoroughly you wash them by hand, they are bound to feel slippery or have an odor. However, perhaps because it is hot-air dried after washing in the dishwasher, they feel squeaky clean and leave no smell! However, for plastic containers that are not made of hard materials like Tritan, deformation may occur, so I recommend using a mode other than Power Mode. Since the dishwasher runs for a while, washing by hand is obviously faster considering the amount of dishes, but I think the reason for using a dishwasher is that it drastically reduces that labor and time. I am so satisfied that I feel it would be hard to go back to the days without one! -----------. Since this is my first time buying a dishwasher, I don't have a specific point of comparison, but it was a successful purchase. It might be difficult to put in a huge number of dishes or wash very large frying pans and pots, but I think the size is more than sufficient for washing a day's worth of dishes for a family of three. I originally intended to purchase a Samsung product of the same 6-place setting, but when I looked at the installation guidelines, there were many restrictions, such as the requirement to drill holes unconditionally. Since I live in a rented apartment, I wasn't keen on drilling holes haphazardly, and I didn't want to bother contacting the landlord; that is why I even run my water purifier by routing the cable under the base cabinet without drilling. Although Midas is a brand I hadn't seen before, I chose it for the following reasons: 1. The reviews are generally positive, and installation is flexible and can be done without drilling depending on the situation. 2. There is a rumor that this brand manufactures products from major corporations via OEM, meaning there is no significant difference in the product itself. 3. Despite this, the price is nearly 200,000 won cheaper. 4. Coupang provides 2 years of free after-sales service. And here are the things I was satisfied with: 1. Simple and neat installation using a T-connector on the existing water purifier cable. 2. Most importantly, it cleans dishes even better than hand washing, leaving them squeaky clean. 3. The noise isn't too loud, and the buttons are intuitive and easy to operate. 4. With the automatic door opening feature, I can leave the dishwasher running while I go out or sleep. 5. The hot air drying function can also be easily set and deactivated. 6. The design is clean and blends well with my white-toned kitchen. 7. The technician was kind, and the installation was fast and accurate. I still need to use it more to know for sure, but now that it has been a few days since installation, I am using it with great satisfaction. After preparing dinner, there used to be a huge pile of dishes; sometimes it would take nearly an hour just to clean up, and my wrists and arms would ache, making it a real struggle. But now I am free from that burden. Most importantly, the biggest advantage is that I now have the time and leisure to do other things instead of washing dishes. However, since the dishwasher runs for over two hours on the standard cycle, you need to be good at Tetris to pack the dishes neatly to use it without wasting them. Also, even if you are using the dishwasher to clean, it is best to rinse the dishes with water once before putting them in. It would be a shame to run it for a long time only to find they aren't clean enough, right? Furthermore, since you eventually have to remove the strainer to clean food residue, I think a minimum amount of labor is necessary for maintenance purposes as well. In conclusion, this dishwasher is the best. I made the right purchase.
