Since this is my first time buying a dishwasher, I don't have a specific point of comparison, but it was a successful purchase. Since I live in a rented apartment, I wasn't keen on drilling holes haphazardly, and I didn't want to bother contacting the landlord; that is why I even run my water purifier by routing the cable under the base cabinet without drilling. The noise isn't too loud, and the buttons are intuitive and easy to operate. 4. With the automatic door opening feature, I can leave the dishwasher running while I go out or sleep. 5. The hot air drying function can also be easily set and deactivated. 6. The design is clean and blends well with my white-toned kitchen. 7. The technician was kind, and the installation was fast and accurate. I still need to use it more to know for sure, but now that it has been a few days since installation, I am using it with great satisfaction. After preparing dinner, there used to be a huge pile of dishes; sometimes it would take nearly an hour just to clean up, and my wrists and arms would ache, making it a real struggle. But now I am free from that burden. Most importantly, the biggest advantage is that I now have the time and leisure to do other things instead of washing dishes. However, since the dishwasher runs for over two hours on the standard cycle, you need to be good at Tetris to pack the dishes neatly to use it without wasting them. Also, even if you are using the dishwasher to clean, it is best to rinse the dishes with water once before putting them in. It would be a shame to run it for a long time only to find they aren't clean enough, right? Furthermore, since you eventually have to remove the strainer to clean food residue, I think a minimum amount of labor is necessary for maintenance purposes as well. In conclusion, this dishwasher is the best. I made the right purchase.

Sentence (English): I made the right purchase.
Comments (English): [ First dishwasher purchase successful ] || ---------------- || April 15, 2026. One-month usage review. I mainly use the Power Mode (89 minutes), which has a relatively short run time. What I am most satisfied with is cleaning plastic containers. When putting side dishes in plastic containers, no matter how thoroughly you wash them by hand, they are bound to feel slippery or have an odor. However, perhaps because it is hot-air dried after washing in the dishwasher, they feel squeaky clean and leave no smell! However, for plastic containers that are not made of hard materials like Tritan, deformation may occur, so I recommend using a mode other than Power Mode. Since the dishwasher runs for a while, washing by hand is obviously faster considering the amount of dishes, but I think the reason for using a dishwasher is that it drastically reduces that labor and time. I am so satisfied that I feel it would be hard to go back to the days without one! -----------. Since this is my first time buying a dishwasher, I don't have a specific point of comparison, but it was a successful purchase. It might be difficult to put in a huge number of dishes or wash very large frying pans and pots, but I think the size is more than sufficient for washing a day's worth of dishes for a family of three. I originally intended to purchase a Samsung product of the same 6-place setting, but when I looked at the installation guidelines, there were many restrictions, such as the requirement to drill holes unconditionally. Since I live in a rented apartment, I wasn't keen on drilling holes haphazardly, and I didn't want to bother contacting the landlord; that is why I even run my water purifier by routing the cable under the base cabinet without drilling. Although Midas is a brand I hadn't seen before, I chose it for the following reasons: 1. The reviews are generally positive, and installation is flexible and can be done without drilling depending on the situation. 2. There is a rumor that this brand manufactures products from major corporations via OEM, meaning there is no significant difference in the product itself. 3. Despite this, the price is nearly 200,000 won cheaper. 4. Coupang provides 2 years of free after-sales service. And here are the things I was satisfied with: 1. Simple and neat installation using a T-connector on the existing water purifier cable. 2. Most importantly, it cleans dishes even better than hand washing, leaving them squeaky clean. 3. The noise isn't too loud, and the buttons are intuitive and easy to operate. 4. With the automatic door opening feature, I can leave the dishwasher running while I go out or sleep. 5. The hot air drying function can also be easily set and deactivated. 6. The design is clean and blends well with my white-toned kitchen. 7. The technician was kind, and the installation was fast and accurate. I still need to use it more to know for sure, but now that it has been a few days since installation, I am using it with great satisfaction. After preparing dinner, there used to be a huge pile of dishes; sometimes it would take nearly an hour just to clean up, and my wrists and arms would ache, making it a real struggle. But now I am free from that burden. Most importantly, the biggest advantage is that I now have the time and leisure to do other things instead of washing dishes. However, since the dishwasher runs for over two hours on the standard cycle, you need to be good at Tetris to pack the dishes neatly to use it without wasting them. Also, even if you are using the dishwasher to clean, it is best to rinse the dishes with water once before putting them in. It would be a shame to run it for a long time only to find they aren't clean enough, right? Furthermore, since you eventually have to remove the strainer to clean food residue, I think a minimum amount of labor is necessary for maintenance purposes as well. In conclusion, this dishwasher is the best. I made the right purchase.

Sentence (English): I purchased the GE Profile 24 in.
Comments (English): I purchased the GE Profile 24 in. Smart Built-In Top Control 44 dBA Fingerprint Resistant Stainless Steel Dishwasher from Home Depot after researching the best GE dishwasher for my household's needs. I also purchased Home Depot's installation and haul-off service.Unfortunately, after only nine loads, about two weeks after installation, the dishwasher began leaking from the bottom corner.I contacted Home Depot immediately. To their credit, they sent technicians out within two business days. The technicians determined the dishwasher needed to be replaced.After that visit there was no follow-up communication, so I called Home Depot to figure out how to get a working dishwasher, which is what I paid for. I was then told the issue had to be sent to GE for their technician to inspect, rather than Home Depot replacing the unit.The GE technician determined the dishwasher needed new seals. After the door was replaced (seals themselves couldn't be replaced; instead, GE replaced the interior door), the dishwasher continued leaking. We also noticed steam was escaping from the top of the dishwasher and condensing on my wood cabinets, likely due to the seals being adjusted.At this point, I had already spent hours calling, sitting on hold, coordinating service visits, and following up. I essentially felt like I was doing the job of managing the repair process myself. I am a business owner, and my time is valuable. When I expressed my frustrations to GE about how unacceptable the situation was and how frustrating their process had been, I was told “that is your opinion,” which only made the situation worse.A second GE service visit was scheduled. During that visit, the technician discovered that the lower spray arm had contacted the heating element and melted, causing water to spray incorrectly and leak from the bottom of the dishwasher. The replacement part had to be ordered and was originally backordered, although it fortunately arrived sooner than expected. Once this was installed, the bottom leaking stopped, but the steam is still making it so that I cannot use the dishwasher because I do not want to ruin my cabinets. The local GE technician is ordering new top seals now. I have effectively been without a properly functioning dishwasher since January 27, and today is March 11.I do want to note that our local GE technician was excellent. He was professional, knowledgeable, and did everything he could to resolve the issue. This review is not a reflection on him.My frustration is with the process. Home Depot should have replaced the defective product that I purchased from them and handled the manufacturer coordination themselves. As the customer who paid for both the appliance and installation service, I should not have had to spend hours managing the situation just to receive a working dishwasher! This experience has been extremely disappointing and should have been handled very differently. After weeks of inconvenience and hours spent trying to resolve this issue, I believe Home Depot should stand behind the products they sell and ensure customers receive a functioning appliance, in a timely manner.

To their credit, they sent technicians out within two business days. The technicians determined the dishwasher needed to be replaced.After that visit there was no follow-up communication, so I called Home Depot to figure out how to get a working dishwasher, which is what I paid for. I was then told the issue had to be sent to GE for their technician to inspect, rather than Home Depot replacing the unit.The GE technician determined the dishwasher needed new seals. After the door was replaced (seals themselves couldn't be replaced; instead, GE replaced the interior door), the dishwasher continued leaking. We also noticed steam was escaping from the top of the dishwasher and condensing on my wood cabinets, likely due to the seals being adjusted.At this point, I had already spent hours calling, sitting on hold, coordinating service visits, and following up. I essentially felt like I was doing the job of managing the repair process myself. I am a business owner, and my time is valuable. When I expressed my frustrations to GE about how unacceptable the situation was and how frustrating their process had been, I was told “that is your opinion,” which only made the situation worse.A second GE service visit was scheduled. During that visit, the technician discovered that the lower spray arm had contacted the heating element and melted, causing water to spray incorrectly and leak from the bottom of the dishwasher. The replacement part had to be ordered and was originally backordered, although it fortunately arrived sooner than expected. Once this was installed, the bottom leaking stopped, but the steam is still making it so that I cannot use the dishwasher because I do not want to ruin my cabinets. The local GE technician is ordering new top seals now. I have effectively been without a properly functioning dishwasher since January 27, and today is March 11.I do want to note that our local GE technician was excellent. He was professional, knowledgeable, and did everything he could to resolve the issue. This review is not a reflection on him.My frustration is with the process. Home Depot should have replaced the defective product that I purchased from them and handled the manufacturer coordination themselves. As the customer who paid for both the appliance and installation service, I should not have had to spend hours managing the situation just to receive a working dishwasher! This experience has been extremely disappointing and should have been handled very differently. After weeks of inconvenience and hours spent trying to resolve this issue, I believe Home Depot should stand behind the products they sell and ensure customers receive a functioning appliance, in a timely manner.

Even though there are triple the amount of prongs for dishes, large bowls and other larger items fit poorly. The third top rack for cutlery is useless unless you want to spend 15 minutes setting every individual spoon and fork into its own holder. The middle rack that you can adjust up or down is nice and we have utilized it multiple times. Other than that it's a dishwasher. It cleans the same as other brands we've had. Sentence (English): I bought a six-person dishwasher as a birthday present, and I wonder why I waited so long to buy it.
Comments (English): [ It's perfect for a family of four. I love it. ] || ---------------- || I bought a six-person dishwasher as a birthday present, and I wonder why I waited so long to buy it. I should have bought it sooner instead of worrying. The cooking quality is different. I love not having to wash dishes. I just rinse them roughly, remove the scum, and put them back in. My husband thought it took too long and thought it was a commercial dishwasher, but it took an hour and a half. He was surprised, saying, "Is this a washing machine?" But I still love it. When I'm in a hurry, I can put it on high speed and it takes 29 minutes. It's so convenient because my back doesn't hurt and I have less dishes to wash.
Comments (Original): [ 4인가족 딱 맞아요 너무 좋아요 ] || ---------------- || 생일 선물로 식세기 6인용으로 샀는데 왜 이제서야 샀나싶어요고민하지말고 일찍 살껄 그랬어요. ㅎㅎㅎ삶은질이 달라요. 설거지 안한다는게 너무 좋아요. 대충 헹궈서 건데기만 떼내고 넣기만 하면 끝남편은 시간이 너무 오래 걸린다고 업소용껀줄 알았는데 1시간반이나 걸린다니 세탁기냐고 놀라긴해도 저는 그래도 너무 좋고. 급할때는 쾌속으로 돌리면 29분 걸려요 허리 안아프고 설거지 줄어서 세상편해요

Sentence (English): I replaced an 11yr Bosch with this new Series 8, hence fitment was a breeze.

However, this new one comes with a wide rubber skirt behind the bottom kick plate.I complained of a loud screech when opening the dishwasher door. The service technician found the problem was the rub of skirt on the kickplate. He agreed there was a lack of installation information, and he best fixed the problem by pushing the kickplate further back into the machine. This works ok, but it is not the look or way of the old Bosch. (ie. Cupboard skirtings don't align.)In all other aspects, this is a great dishwasher.

Sentence (English): This is our second Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Bosch still rules, with quirks worth knowing ] || ---------------- || This is our second Bosch dishwasher. We had our first Integra 800 model with the FootLight years ago, loved it. The only issues were a loose towel bar handle (easily fixed) and had to replace the inlet valve due to the perfect sized chunk of rust in the feed line getting through the filter and jamming the valve. We've since left that one behind in a move, and bought this one. It's built on par, and cleans even better.Yes it is not a plug and play swap with a 'standard' dishwasher, you might need to get some inlet adapters, or cut a hole larger, or wire into a new outlet instead of wiring into the appliance directly like the old dishwasher. All doable, but get a installer to do it right if you are hesitant. Worth it, this one cleans even better and the all-stainless interior is the way to go. I believe it's important to understand just what makes this fancy machine special, so I suggest watching the video on Yootube (title in quotes) "An up close look at the BOSCH 800 Series dishwashers! ", this salesman does by far the best walkthrough of a series 800 dishwasher I've ever seen. Explains everything, all the controls, the washing modes, how they work with temperatures and dish loads, the way they interact with the wash arms, and all the rack adjustability features. Everything in my Bosch experience validates the instructional video as spot-on and deserves credit for really helpful guidance. I sent the video to my wife who was amazed to learn things about features she'd forgotten or didn't realize the old one had and loved knowing way better how all of this one works! Keeping a shortcut on her desktop.So, yeah, we love this one too,

I would definitely recommend it.

Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher, feature rich and good value!  ] || ---------------- || I got this dishwasher to replace the aging one in my pool house. I have a 300 series in my house, so when it came time for a new one in the pool house, I wouldn't want anything other than a Bosch. The 100 series was my choice for this application. This thing is super quite and very spacious inside. It has 2 racks and they both have ample space. The detergent door slides, which is a great design to keep dishes from blocking it from opening. The silverware tray is movable and the right size. It connects to the internet and you can run or check the status from the app. You can toggle settings in the app that are not available on the front controls. Installation is straight forward. You will need a water hookup adaptor and water supply line, those are not included. This dishwasher plugs into a standard wall outlet, if your old one was hard wired you will need to put in an outlet. I love the leveling screws that Bosch uses. I love the red dot on the floor when the machine is running - really helpful since it's so quiet and otherwise you don't know if it's running. I have to really pay attention to get them to fit. But my main complaint (3) pulling out the bottom tray almost always makes it come off the tracks. It drives me nuts. Esp when it's heavy and half filled. Overall, we're happy with the job it does, but these three user experience items could have been solved with a UX designer.

Comments (English): [ I'm using it well. ] || ---------------- || These days, washing dishes takes up the most time among all household chores. After much consideration, I decided to install the LG DIOS Objet Collection Dishwasher DUE1BGLE. To start with the conclusion, it is an appliance I am so satisfied with that I wonder why I didn't get it sooner. This product is a 12-place setting built-in dishwasher, a suitable capacity for a family of 3 to 5 people. As a family of three including a 7-year-old child, we debated between the 12-place and 14-place setting models before deciding on this one. In actual use, I found it incredibly convenient to be able to load more dishes than expected at once, allowing me to finish the dishwashing in one go after dinner. Most pots and pans fit inside, so it feels like kitchen work has been significantly reduced. The most satisfying aspect was its cleaning power. Even greasy dishes and plates with sauce stains come out clean, and I liked that the high-temperature washing function allows for hygienic maintenance. Comments (English): [ I'm using it well. ] || ---------------- || These days, washing dishes takes up the most time among all household chores. After much consideration, I decided to install the LG DIOS Objet Collection Dishwasher DUE1BGLE. To start with the conclusion, it is an appliance I am so satisfied with that I wonder why I didn't get it sooner. This product is a 12-place setting built-in dishwasher, a suitable capacity for a family of 3 to 5 people. As a family of three including a 7-year-old child, we debated between the 12-place and 14-place setting models before deciding on this one. In actual use, I found it incredibly convenient to be able to load more dishes than expected at once, allowing me to finish the dishwashing in one go after dinner. Most pots and pans fit inside, so it feels like kitchen work has been significantly reduced. The most satisfying aspect was its cleaning power. Even greasy dishes and plates with sauce stains come out clean, and I liked that the high-temperature washing function allows for hygienic maintenance. This would be a significant advantage in terms of hygiene, especially for households with children. Another great feature is the automatic door opening drying function. Once the wash is finished, the door automatically opens to naturally release internal moisture, resulting in fewer water stains and better drying. The drying performance of the product I used previously was a bit lacking, but thanks to this feature, the dishes finish much fresher and drier. The noise level is also quieter than expected. Even when running a scheduled wash at night, it isn't particularly bothersome, so I can use it without worry while sleeping. Additionally, the smart features allow for status checks and simple diagnostics via the app, making maintenance convenient. The design is also a satisfying aspect. The Nature Beige color, signature of the Objet Collection, blends well with kitchen interiors, creating a clean and sleek look when installed as a built-in unit. I liked how it blends in naturally, like kitchen furniture rather than just an appliance. If I had to point out a drawback, it would be that since it is a built-in product, you need to check the space during the initial installation. However, once installed, it significantly reduces the time spent on daily dishwashing, so I believe it is a product worth being fully satisfied with. Since we moved in after a complete renovation, we secured the space in advance; however, it is a shame that the interior design team made a slight mistake regarding the height, resulting in a slight difference in level. Please make sure to check this! Overall, I felt that this dishwasher offers a good balance of cleaning power, hygiene, convenience, and design, and I would recommend it to anyone looking to reduce dishwashing stress. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I believe this model is definitely worth considering.

Sentence (English): Most pots and pans fit inside, so it feels like kitchen work has been significantly reduced.
Comments (English): [ I'm using it well. ] || ---------------- || These days, washing dishes takes up the most time among all household chores. After much consideration, I decided to install the LG DIOS Objet Collection Dishwasher DUE1BGLE. To start with the conclusion, it is an appliance I am so satisfied with that I wonder why I didn't get it sooner. This product is a 12-place setting built-in dishwasher, a suitable capacity for a family of 3 to 5 people. As a family of three including a 7-year-old child, we debated between the 12-place and 14-place setting models before deciding on this one. In actual use, I found it incredibly convenient to be able to load more dishes than expected at once, allowing me to finish the dishwashing in one go after dinner. Most pots and pans fit inside, so it feels like kitchen work has been significantly reduced. The most satisfying aspect was its cleaning power. Even greasy dishes and plates with sauce stains come out clean, and I liked that the high-temperature washing function allows for hygienic maintenance. This would be a significant advantage in terms of hygiene, especially for households with children. Another great feature is the automatic door opening drying function. Once the wash is finished, the door automatically opens to naturally release internal moisture, resulting in fewer water stains and better drying. The drying performance of the product I used previously was a bit lacking, but thanks to this feature, the dishes finish much fresher and drier. The noise level is also quieter than expected. Even when running a scheduled wash at night, it isn't particularly bothersome, so I can use it without worry while sleeping. Additionally, the smart features allow for status checks and simple diagnostics via the app, making maintenance convenient. The design is also a satisfying aspect. The Nature Beige color, signature of the Objet Collection, blends well with kitchen interiors, creating a clean and sleek look when installed as a built-in unit. I liked how it blends in naturally, like kitchen furniture rather than just an appliance. If I had to point out a drawback, it would be that since it is a built-in product, you need to check the space during the initial installation. However, once installed, it significantly reduces the time spent on daily dishwashing, so I believe it is a product worth being fully satisfied with. Since we moved in after a complete renovation, we secured the space in advance; however, it is a shame that the interior design team made a slight mistake regarding the height, resulting in a slight difference in level. Please make sure to check this! Overall, I felt that this dishwasher offers a good balance of cleaning power, hygiene, convenience, and design, and I would recommend it to anyone looking to reduce dishwashing stress. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I believe this model is definitely worth considering.

Comments (English): [ I'm using it well. ] || ---------------- || These days, washing dishes takes up the most time among all household chores. After much consideration, I decided to install the LG DIOS Objet Collection Dishwasher DUE1BGLE. To start with the conclusion, it is an appliance I am so satisfied with that I wonder why I didn't get it sooner. This product is a 12-place setting built-in dishwasher, a suitable capacity for a family of 3 to 5 people. As a family of three including a 7-year-old child, we debated between the 12-place and 14-place setting models before deciding on this one. In actual use, I found it incredibly convenient to be able to load more dishes than expected at once, allowing me to finish the dishwashing in one go after dinner. Most pots and pans fit inside, so it feels like kitchen work has been significantly reduced. The most satisfying aspect was its cleaning power. Even greasy dishes and plates with sauce stains come out clean, and I liked that the high-temperature washing function allows for hygienic maintenance. This would be a significant advantage in terms of hygiene, especially for households with children. Another great feature is the automatic door opening drying function. Once the wash is finished, the door automatically opens to naturally release internal moisture, resulting in fewer water stains and better drying. The drying performance of the product I used previously was a bit lacking, but thanks to this feature, the dishes finish much fresher and drier. The noise level is also quieter than expected. Even when running a scheduled wash at night, it isn't particularly bothersome, so I can use it without worry while sleeping. Additionally, the smart features allow for status checks and simple diagnostics via the app, making maintenance convenient. The design is also a satisfying aspect. The Nature Beige color, signature of the Objet Collection, blends well with kitchen interiors, creating a clean and sleek look when installed as a built-in unit. I liked how it blends in naturally, like kitchen furniture rather than just an appliance. If I had to point out a drawback, it would be that since it is a built-in product, you need to check the space during the initial installation. However, once installed, it significantly reduces the time spent on daily dishwashing, so I believe it is a product worth being fully satisfied with. Since we moved in after a complete renovation, we secured the space in advance; however, it is a shame that the interior design team made a slight mistake regarding the height, resulting in a slight difference in level. Please make sure to check this! Overall, I felt that this dishwasher offers a good balance of cleaning power, hygiene, convenience, and design, and I would recommend it to anyone looking to reduce dishwashing stress. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I believe this model is definitely worth considering.

Comments (English): [ I'm using it well. ] || ---------------- || These days, washing dishes takes up the most time among all household chores. After much consideration, I decided to install the LG DIOS Objet Collection Dishwasher DUE1BGLE. To start with the conclusion, it is an appliance I am so satisfied with that I wonder why I didn't get it sooner. This product is a 12-place setting built-in dishwasher, a suitable capacity for a family of 3 to 5 people. As a family of three including a 7-year-old child, we debated between the 12-place and 14-place setting models before deciding on this one. In actual use, I found it incredibly convenient to be able to load more dishes than expected at once, allowing me to finish the dishwashing in one go after dinner. Most pots and pans fit inside, so it feels like kitchen work has been significantly reduced. The most satisfying aspect was its cleaning power. Even greasy dishes and plates with sauce stains come out clean, and I liked that the high-temperature washing function allows for hygienic maintenance. This would be a significant advantage in terms of hygiene, especially for households with children. Another great feature is the automatic door opening drying function. Once the wash is finished, the door automatically opens to naturally release internal moisture, resulting in fewer water stains and better drying. The drying performance of the product I used previously was a bit lacking, but thanks to this feature, the dishes finish much fresher and drier. The noise level is also quieter than expected. Even when running a scheduled wash at night, it isn't particularly bothersome, so I can use it without worry while sleeping. Additionally, the smart features allow for status checks and simple diagnostics via the app, making maintenance convenient. The design is also a satisfying aspect. The Nature Beige color, signature of the Objet Collection, blends well with kitchen interiors, creating a clean and sleek look when installed as a built-in unit. I liked how it blends in naturally, like kitchen furniture rather than just an appliance. If I had to point out a drawback, it would be that since it is a built-in product, you need to check the space during the initial installation. However, once installed, it significantly reduces the time spent on daily dishwashing, so I believe it is a product worth being fully satisfied with. Since we moved in after a complete renovation, we secured the space in advance; however, it is a shame that the interior design team made a slight mistake regarding the height, resulting in a slight difference in level. Please make sure to check this! Overall, I felt that this dishwasher offers a good balance of cleaning power, hygiene, convenience, and design, and I would recommend it to anyone looking to reduce dishwashing stress. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I believe this model is definitely worth considering.

Additionally, the smart features allow for status checks and simple diagnostics via the app, making maintenance convenient. The design is also a satisfying aspect. Comments (English): [ I'm using it well. ] || ---------------- || These days, washing dishes takes up the most time among all household chores. After much consideration, I decided to install the LG DIOS Objet Collection Dishwasher DUE1BGLE. To start with the conclusion, it is an appliance I am so satisfied with that I wonder why I didn't get it sooner. This product is a 12-place setting built-in dishwasher, a suitable capacity for a family of 3 to 5 people. As a family of three including a 7-year-old child, we debated between the 12-place and 14-place setting models before deciding on this one. In actual use, I found it incredibly convenient to be able to load more dishes than expected at once, allowing me to finish the dishwashing in one go after dinner. Most pots and pans fit inside, so it feels like kitchen work has been significantly reduced. The most satisfying aspect was its cleaning power. Even greasy dishes and plates with sauce stains come out clean, and I liked that the high-temperature washing function allows for hygienic maintenance. This would be a significant advantage in terms of hygiene, especially for households with children. Another great feature is the automatic door opening drying function. Once the wash is finished, the door automatically opens to naturally release internal moisture, resulting in fewer water stains and better drying. The drying performance of the product I used previously was a bit lacking, but thanks to this feature, the dishes finish much fresher and drier. The noise level is also quieter than expected. Even when running a scheduled wash at night, it isn't particularly bothersome, so I can use it without worry while sleeping. Additionally, the smart features allow for status checks and simple diagnostics via the app, making maintenance convenient. The design is also a satisfying aspect. The Nature Beige color, signature of the Objet Collection, blends well with kitchen interiors, creating a clean and sleek look when installed as a built-in unit. I liked how it blends in naturally, like kitchen furniture rather than just an appliance. If I had to point out a drawback, it would be that since it is a built-in product, you need to check the space during the initial installation. However, once installed, it significantly reduces the time spent on daily dishwashing, so I believe it is a product worth being fully satisfied with. Since we moved in after a complete renovation, we secured the space in advance; however, it is a shame that the interior design team made a slight mistake regarding the height, resulting in a slight difference in level. Please make sure to check this! Overall, I felt that this dishwasher offers a good balance of cleaning power, hygiene, convenience, and design, and I would recommend it to anyone looking to reduce dishwashing stress. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I believe this model is definitely worth considering.

Sentence (English): If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I believe this model is definitely worth considering.
Comments (English): [ I'm using it well. ] || ---------------- || These days, washing dishes takes up the most time among all household chores. After much consideration, I decided to install the LG DIOS Objet Collection Dishwasher DUE1BGLE. To start with the conclusion, it is an appliance I am so satisfied with that I wonder why I didn't get it sooner. This product is a 12-place setting built-in dishwasher, a suitable capacity for a family of 3 to 5 people. As a family of three including a 7-year-old child, we debated between the 12-place and 14-place setting models before deciding on this one. In actual use, I found it incredibly convenient to be able to load more dishes than expected at once, allowing me to finish the dishwashing in one go after dinner. Most pots and pans fit inside, so it feels like kitchen work has been significantly reduced. The most satisfying aspect was its cleaning power. Even greasy dishes and plates with sauce stains come out clean, and I liked that the high-temperature washing function allows for hygienic maintenance. This would be a significant advantage in terms of hygiene, especially for households with children. Another great feature is the automatic door opening drying function. Once the wash is finished, the door automatically opens to naturally release internal moisture, resulting in fewer water stains and better drying. The drying performance of the product I used previously was a bit lacking, but thanks to this feature, the dishes finish much fresher and drier. The noise level is also quieter than expected. Even when running a scheduled wash at night, it isn't particularly bothersome, so I can use it without worry while sleeping. Additionally, the smart features allow for status checks and simple diagnostics via the app, making maintenance convenient. The design is also a satisfying aspect. The Nature Beige color, signature of the Objet Collection, blends well with kitchen interiors, creating a clean and sleek look when installed as a built-in unit. I liked how it blends in naturally, like kitchen furniture rather than just an appliance. If I had to point out a drawback, it would be that since it is a built-in product, you need to check the space during the initial installation. However, once installed, it significantly reduces the time spent on daily dishwashing, so I believe it is a product worth being fully satisfied with. Since we moved in after a complete renovation, we secured the space in advance; however, it is a shame that the interior design team made a slight mistake regarding the height, resulting in a slight difference in level. Please make sure to check this! Overall, I felt that this dishwasher offers a good balance of cleaning power, hygiene, convenience, and design, and I would recommend it to anyone looking to reduce dishwashing stress. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher, I believe this model is definitely worth considering.

Sentence (English): I can't believe this is supposed to seat 14 people.

Also, water accumulates in the middle blade, so even if you accidentally touch the shelf with the hot air dryer, it rains down on the bottom, which is inconvenient. I hope the next product will include a feature that spins the middle blade a few times after washing to remove some of the remaining water.

Sentence (English): I chose this appliance after careful consideration as a newlywed appliance, and it exceeded my expectations, so I'm quite satisfied.
Comments (English): [ Clean without pre-washing! A great item that reduces dishwashing stress. ] || ---------------- || I chose this appliance after careful consideration as a newlywed appliance, and it exceeded my expectations, so I'm quite satisfied. I was truly surprised to see that even a burnt-out pot was cleaned without pre-washing. Even areas that were difficult to remove by hand were cleaned so thoroughly that I wondered if I had been worrying too much. Deep tumblers are difficult to reach into and wash, but putting it in the dishwasher sterilizes it with hot water and thoroughly cleans the inside, which is incredibly convenient and reassuring. It's significantly reduced the stress of washing dishes. Another great feature is that you can open the door while the dishwasher is running and add more dishes. If you forget to put a cup or plate in, you can just put it back in, making it much more convenient. My home is decorated in Hansol Fog Gray, and I also like how the color blends in so well without detracting from the kitchen's overall aesthetic. The appliances don't stand out, but rather blend in naturally. I remember there were two installers. One precisely cut the wooden boards to fit the built-in dimensions, and the other kindly explained how to use it after installation. The only downside was that the music that played when the installation was complete was louder and longer than I expected, which surprised me a bit at first. Still, it definitely let me know it was finished.

Sentence (English): I wanted to make kitchen organization a little easier, so I researched various options and ended up purchasing a Samsung Electronics Bespoke 6-seater countertop dishwasher.
Comments (English): I wanted to make kitchen organization a little easier, so I researched various options and ended up purchasing a Samsung Electronics Bespoke 6-seater countertop dishwasher. I originally used a built-in 12-seater, but as I started eating out more, I realized I didn't really need a larger unit. I chose this one because it took up less kitchen space and seemed more convenient. After using it, I was more satisfied than I expected, so I'm leaving a review. Before, I used to get a lot of dishes piled up, so using the Samsung countertop dishwasher greatly reduced that burden. Even though it's a 6-seater, the inside of the Samsung countertop dishwasher is spacious enough to hold dishes, cups, and spoons, so most of the dishes after a family meal are done in one go. It's incredibly convenient to run the Samsung countertop dishwasher right after dinner and have clean, dry dishes the next morning. Especially for families with children, the Samsung countertop dishwasher is a huge time-saver. The design is clean, so placing the Samsung countertop dishwasher on top of the kitchen doesn't seem out of place, and I really like the Bespoke's signature minimalist feel. A tip: Rinsing food before loading it into the Samsung countertop dishwasher significantly improves its cleaning power. One downside is that it's difficult to fit pots and large pans into the Samsung countertop dishwasher, but that's just a countertop feature. Still, considering the price, the Samsung countertop dishwasher is highly satisfying in terms of space utilization and convenience. Before, the sink was always full of dishes, but after using it, it cleared away instantly, and my family said it looked much cleaner. Next time, I plan to try organizing the dishes more efficiently and take full advantage of its cleaning power. Sentence (English): This dishwasher performs well.
Comments (English): [ SOUND INSULATION BLANKET was removed by installer! ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher performs well. It washes well and the "Pro Dry Max" feature gets everything really dry.Unfortunately, the installers sent by Costco had to come 4 times because so many errors were made during the installation. Our KDTS624SPS was installed without the SOUND INSULATION BLANKET! This is why its humming and grinding noises were migraine-inducing. I only figured this out because I contacted Kitchenaid on INSTAGRAM. I basically had to take a training course on dishwasher installation in order to make sure that the installation was finally corrected. I also had to print and read the installation instructions myself because the installers do not do this.Dishwasher installation checklist:-Make sure the white SOUND INSULATION BLANKET is not removed prior to installation! This Kitchenaid dishwasher will be insanely noisy without the sound blanket.-Make sure that the drain hose is installed on a HIGH LOOP underneath the kitchen sink.-Make sure that the dishwasher is LEVEL, both vertically and horizontally. -The dishwasher should be secured to the rough opening with TWO SIDE ANCHORS if it cannot be secured to the underside of the counter. Make sure that the installers do not drive a 3rd screw into the bottom of the dishwasher by the kickplate! This does not provide stability and can actually damage the dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ Best dishwasher we have owned ] || ---------------- || Although I wanted to buy a Bosch, I was very skeptical & reluctant to download & use an app for the delayed start feature (I use this feature each night to run our dishwasher outside of our water softener's recharge window). My husband finally talked me into this model & I am very happy. Over the last 11 years, we have had a Kenmore (original to the home), LG, & Whirlpool. after our Whirlpool needed yet another repair, we decided to replace it with a more reliable brand. I like using the app more than I'd like to admit. We have been using just over a month and I have loading the machine down to a science. The design of the racks took some getting used to, while at first appearing smaller in capacity than our previous dishwashers, I've found that I am actually able to fit more dishes on. You can tell a lot of thought went into its efficient design. My biggest complaint is that there is still a "plastic-y" smell after drying. most of our dishes are metal, glass, & ceramic, with a few silicone, plastic, rubber items mixed in. Not a big deal. Also, our water is one that creates an awful fishy smell when mixed with rinse-aids. such an odd phenomenon. we stopped filling the rinse aid and the smell disappeared. All and all, highly recommend!

Sentence (English): Our new Bosch dishwasher was installed recently so I can't speak to its long term performance.
Comments (English): [ Tar-like smell ] || ---------------- || Our new Bosch dishwasher was installed recently so I can't speak to its long term performance. What I can comment on is the tar-like odor off-gassing from the machine. Our main requirement when we chose this model was that we wanted a reliable workhorse, particularly since our last dishwasher (an LG) from Lowe's stopped drying after only one year. A bonus feature of this Bosch model is that it's less noisy. Unfortunately the material (bitumen) that is used for insulation and sound-proofing is what is causing the same odor that you would smell near repair work for roofs and new roads. I'm told it will take a month for the off-gassing to stop. Had I know this, I would not have chosen this model. An expensive lesson learned.

Sentence (English): Before I start on the features I dislike, I want to say the dishes come outspotlessly clean & this unit is unbelievably quiet.
Comments (English): [ SHP78CF5N ] || ---------------- || Before I start on the features I dislike, I want to say the dishes come outspotlessly clean & this unit is unbelievably quiet. 1. I was surprised to find no handle that doubles as atowel rack. Since I bought this unit online from a very small photo, I had no idea that it lacked this feature as I assumed it was like every other dishwasher I've seen. Furthermore lacking this feature, it makes it almost impossible for my 86 year old wife to fully open the heavy front door. I ended up buying an external towel rack. 2.The runners on the racks have no external stops . I frequently find that I have to empty all the dishes so I can get the runners back ontrack. 3.The removable untensil accessory is inadequate & I had to buy a larger one that supposedly fits a number of dishwashers. 4.The 3rd rack is unusable because it is never dry & drips water either empty or loaded. I always use the ZEOLITE option. 5.Most annoying is that the unit won't start unless the RESET button is pushed. I've read in several places that this is a common problem & that the fix is a service call to adjust the door switch. Knowing this, Bosch should either test this before shipping the unit / redesign it.

Sentence (English): I've had this model about a month, replacing my 15 year old Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Still a Bosch dishwasher fan ] || ---------------- || I've had this model about a month, replacing my 15 year old Bosch dishwasher. Once you get the hang of Wifi and connectivity, it is very easy to use. Naturally, it cleans beautifully and there are many options. I haven't used them all. My old Bosch had a double silverware basket, which I kept and am using in this machine. It's easier to sort flatware that way. I do use the third drawer for lids, yogurt container, tongs and scissors, cat food cans -- anything that fits really. I have two niggles. One is the folding shelves on the right side of the upper rack. I very much wish they folded down instead of up as in the old machine. Also, the two old shelves extended the full length of the drawer and did not need to be locked by sliding. I also liked the double tines in the upper rack. The other issue is that my slightly unconventional crockery (East Fork) doesn't load particularly well on the bottom rack. However, the smaller pieces do fit very nicely in the upper rack. I stress that these are quibbles. Overall, I'm quite happy with my new dishwasher.

I installed it in the same spot where my previous small dishwasher from Brand D was, but since I have to open the cabinet door above the sink to fit it, I had no choice but to place it right next to the dishwasher; consequently, dishes often bump against the wall when I load them. Sentence (English): I heard LG dishwashers are good, so I bought one and purposely added LG dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid.
Comments (English): I heard LG dishwashers are good, so I bought one and purposely added LG dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid. However, even though I only added a small amount, the detergent and rinse aid containers started leaking out before I even finished washing the dishes. I called the installer, who told me it was because I had used liquid detergent and suggested I use solid detergent instead. He also said that rinse aid leaks easily and that I didn't need to add it. Actually, this was my first time buying a dishwasher, and since we're a two-person household, we didn't use it much, so we were using it without detergent or rinse aid. However, I recently hurt my hand and I can't let water get on my hands, so when I tried to use the dishwasher, I ended up using detergent and rinse aid, and this problem occurred. When I contacted AI, they said that the detergent specifically for LG dishwashers is more viscous than regular dishwashing detergent, so if the detergent cap is properly closed, it won't flow out. If the rinse aid flows all the way to the rinse aid container, there's a problem with the detergent and rinse aid container. The technician in charge of installation said that he explained it to me in detail, and that if I hadn't insisted on going quickly, he would have explained it in detail for more than 30 minutes. I could have told him to go first because I was busy, but the technician just installed it, gave me a quick 5-minute explanation, and left. I never received a detailed explanation, and I had heard that I had to add salt before starting, so I had already bought some and added it. First of all, I couldn't fight with the technician by raising my voice, so I just heard an explanation why I shouldn't use liquid detergent and that it was the original way LG dishwashers were made, and I thought that from now on, I should use solid detergent and not use rinse aid. However, when I asked the AI, it said that if detergent/rinse flows when you put in a small amount of detergent/rinse aid, close the lid tightly, and raise the door before operation, it is a problem with the detergent/rinse aid container and you should replace it. I apologize for the confusion caused by the technician's answer. Also, the reason I can write such a long post is because the customer center consultation phone number is not working and there is no response.
Comments (Original): LG식기세척기가 좋다고 들어서 샀으며,  일부러 LG 식기세척기 전용 세제와 린스를 사서 넣었다. 그런데, 세제와 린스를 소량만 넣었음에도 식기세척을 하기 전부터 세제와 린스가 세제통 및 린스통에서 줄줄 샜다.  설치기사에게 전화했더니, 액체세제를 넣어서 그런 거라며, 고체세제를 넣으라고 했다. 또한 린스는 원래 잘 새는 거라며, 굳이 안 넣어도 된다고 말했다. 사실 식기세척기를 처음 사는 것이고 2인 가족이라 잘 쓰지도 않는 것이라 세제와 린스 없이 사용 중이었다가 요즘 손을 다쳐서 물이 손에 닿으면 안 되서 식기세척기를 쓰려다 보니 세제와 린스를 사용하여 식기세척기를 돌렸는데 이런 문제가 발생하였으며, AI 에 문의하니, LG 식기세척기 전용세제는 일반 주방세제와는 다르게 점성이 강해서 세제뚜껑을 잘 닫았을 경우에는 밖으로 흐르지 않으며, 만일 린스통에서까지 린스가 흐르면,  세제 및 린스통에 문제가 있는 것이라고 하였다. 설치 당시 담당 기사는 나에게 자세히 설명을 해주었다고 말했고, 내가 굳이 빨리 가보라고 하지 않으면 30분 이상 자세히 설명했을 것이라고 말했다. 내가 바쁘니 먼저 가라고 했을 수도 있지만, 기사는 설치만 하고 빠르게 5분 정도 설명한 후 가버렸으며, 나는 자세한 설명을 들은 적이 없고, 시작 전에 소금을 꼭 넣으라는 말은 듣고 소금을 미리 사서 넣고 사용하고 있었다.일단 굳이 기사와 언성을 높여 싸울 수도 없고 그냥 왜 액체세제를 넣으면 안 되는지와 원래 LG 식기세척기가 생겨먹은 게 그런 것이라는 설명을 듣고 다음부터는 고체세제를 넣고 린스는 쓰지 말아야겠다고 생각했는데, AI 에 물어보니, 소량의 세제/린스 넣고 뚜껑을 꽉 닫고 작동 전에 문을 세웠을 때 세제/린스가 흐르면,세제/린스통의 문제이니 교체해달라고 하는 게 맞으며, 기사의 답변 때문에 혼선이 생겨 고생 많았다고 하더라. 또한 이렇게 글을 길게 적을 수 있는 이유는 고객센터 상담전화가 되지 않고 응답전화도 오지 않기 때문이다

Sentence (English): Living without a dishwasher is so convenient.
Comments (English): Living without a dishwasher is so convenient. I was worried it might be too small since it's a 6-place setting, but it works. You just need to pack it in properly; if it doesn't fit, you can simply soak it and run it again the next day. If you get greedy and pack too much without leaving any gaps, it won't clean well, so it's better to run it later. However, it is unavoidable that the sink looks a bit messy. I placed it where the existing drying rack is, and since there isn't a drying rack other than under the cabinet, I can just take out the washed dishes right away. I was worried about a lack of space, but it doesn't feel insufficient. Using it is really simple—you just put in detergent and press the button—and it isn't very noisy. Even if I run it at night, it doesn't disturb the neighbors upstairs or downstairs at all. At first, I laughed and asked what the difference was between pre-washing and regular dishwashing, but after using it, I realized it is different. Instead of just roughly scrubbing soaked dishes with a sponge and putting them in, I don't have to scrub each one with detergent and rinse them thoroughly with warm water, so I have a lot of free time. The only downside isn't the dishwasher itself, but our sink is small so we can't fit it sideways, which is a bit inconvenient, but there is nothing we can do about it. If your sink were a bit bigger, it would be great to be able to rotate it sideways. And just consider whether you need it or not; when you make a purchase, just buy it here. It is Samsung, the brand you can trust, isn't it?
